title: Online Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at eFLY Marketplace Services GmbH
description_html:
In der Rolle des Online Marketing Managers (m/w/d) kalkulierst und steuerst du die Werbebudgets unserer Kunden. Ziel ist es die bestmögliche Sichtbarkeit mit einem vorgegebenen Budget zu erreichen. Um die Fortschritte der Arbeit auch dem Kunden zu übermitteln, werden regelmäßig Auswertungen erstellt. Auch die Positionierung der Produkte an gewünschten Werbeplätzen spielt hierbei eine große Rolle.🚀

Aufgaben

  • Strategieerarbeitung: Entwicklung von SEA-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Account Managern, um Werbepotenziale auf Amazon optimal auszuschöpfen und auszubauen.
  • Keyword-Recherche & SEO-Optimierung: Durchführung von Keyword-Recherchen sowie On- und Offpage-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Kampagnenleistung.
  • Kampagnenoptimierung: Maximierung des Kampagnenpotenzials durch fortlaufende Optimierung und Überwachung der Kampagnen, um die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
  • Datenanalyse & Maßnahmenableitung: Analyse der Kampagnendaten mit Hilfe von Analyse-Tools und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Performance.
  • Reporting: Aufbau und Pflege von Reportings zur transparenten Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Erfolge der Kampagnen für den Kunden.
  • Amazon Seller Central: Nutzung und Verwaltung des Amazon Seller Central zur Überwachung und Steuerung von Kampagnen.
  • PPC-Optimierung: Anpassung und Optimierung der PPC-Preise auf Basis zuvor festgelegter Strategien, um die Effizienz und den ROI der Werbemaßnahmen zu maximieren.

Qualifikation

  • Kaufmännische Ausbildung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Kaufmann/-frau für E-Commerce oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich.
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und bist in der Lage, Aufgaben effizient und selbstständig zu bewältigen.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du hast die Fähigkeit, dich schnell in neue Themenfelder einzuarbeiten und komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen.
  • Team- und Kommunikationsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne im Team und bist in der Lage, dich klar und präzise schriftlich sowie mündlich zu äußern.
  • Analytisches Denken: Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Zahlen und die Fähigkeit, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen, zeichnen dich aus.
  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Deine schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikation ist klar und gut organisiert.
  • Technisches Know-how: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel und PowerPoint gehören zu deinem Repertoire, um Kampagnenanalysen und Präsentationen professionell zu erstellen.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
  • Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
  • Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
  • Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben.

title: Junior Google Performance & Analytics Manager (m/w/d)

description_html:
In dieser Position bist du für die operative Umsetzung unseres Google-Marketings zuständig. Während die Strategie und das technische Setup vorgegeben werden, verantwortest du das fehlerfreie Einbuchen, die tägliche Pflege und das exakte Monitoring unserer Google-Ads-Kampagnen. Du hältst dem Team im Tagesgeschäft den Rücken frei, überwachst die Budgets nach klaren Vorgaben und bereitest die Performance-Daten in übersichtlichen Reportings auf. Durch deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kampagnen verlässlich laufen und optimiert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Kampagnen-Setup & Pflege: Du buchst Google-Ads-Kampagnen (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) nach klaren Vorgaben ein und pflegst Anzeigen, Texte sowie Budgets im System.
  • Tägliches Monitoring: Du überwachst laufend die Performance und die Tagesbudgets unserer Accounts, um einen reibungslosen und fehlerfreien Ablauf der Kampagnen sicherzustellen.
  • Datenpflege & Reporting: Du exportierst regelmäßig die Leistungsdaten der Werbekampagnen und bereitest diese in übersichtlichen Excel-Listen oder Dashboards für das Management auf.
  • Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Du unterstützt bei der täglichen Organisation der Marketing-Aktivitäten, übernimmst die Abstimmung von Werbemitteln (wie Bildern und Texten) und erledigst anfallende Routineaufgaben im Account.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung oder Studium: Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung mit.
  • Erste Marketing-Einblicke: Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im digitalen Marketing gesammelt (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder erste Berufsschritte).
  • Google-Kenntnisse als Plus: Idealerweise hast du schon mal mit Google Ads oder Analyse-Tools gearbeitet – das ist ein großer Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, dich schnell in diese Systeme einzuarbeiten.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du bist absolut zuverlässig, arbeitest extrem gewissenhaft und prüfst deine Aufgaben lieber doppelt, bevor etwas online geht.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen: Du hast eine gute Affinität zu Daten und kannst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets umgehen, um Listen und Tabellen zu pflegen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
  • Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
  • Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
  • Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben

title: Internship - Hr & Talent Acquisition Specialist
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Quandela
description_html:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions .

We’re seeking a HR & Talent Acquisition Specialist Intern to join our vibrant team and help us attract the best talents as we continue to expand in the quantum computing sector, ideally to start in October. Alongside recruitment, you’ll also play a pivotal role in managing and developing our campus presence, fostering connections with top universities and student communities and supporting our HR Operations. 

You’ll work closely with hiring managers to understand their requirements for new talent—whether for interns or junior professional hires—and develop tailored strategies to meet those needs effectively. 

Your Key Responsibilities: 

Recruitment & Onboarding of our interns : 

  • Support the full recruitment cycle, from job postings to onboarding new hires. 
  • Provide support for HR administrative processes, including internship agreements, new intern registrations (Lucca HRIS), onboarding sessions, training coordination, etc. 
  • Create engaging job descriptions and employer branding materials. 
  • Maintain and update our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) for accurate data tracking. 
  • Monitor recruitment metrics and report on key performance indicators (KPIs). 

  

Support Hiring Managers: 

  • Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their staffing needs for interns.
  • Provide expert assistance throughout the recruitment process to ensure it is smooth and efficient. 
  • Act as a trusted advisor, offering guidance on candidate selection and recruitment best practices. 

  

Campus Management & Development: 

  • Develop and execute strategies to enhance our campus presence, including building relationships with universities, student organizations, and career centers. 
  • Organize and represent the company at campus events such as career fairs, workshops, and tech talks. 
  • Collaborate with academic institutions to create internship programs and talent pipelines. 
  • Identify opportunities to sponsor or host events that align with our employer branding goals. 

Requirements

  • You are pursuing a Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. This position is only valid with an Internship Agreement
  • Seeking a 4/6-month end-of-study or gap-year internship. 
  • Passionate about recruitment, with an interest in working in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment. 
  • Required experience in HR Ops and recruitment through internships or academic projects. 
  • Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with online recruiting platforms and social media. 
  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in French and English. 

Benefits

  • Swile Card (meal vouchers) 🍴🛒
  • 50% participation in transportation costs 🚆
  • Possibility of remote work 💻
  • Internship Allowance between €1,200 and €1,400 per month 💰
  • 1,5 days off per month, cumulative 🧳

What we also offer

A challenging and innovative work environment at the heart of quantum computing. 

A diverse and collaborative company culture. 

Opportunities for professional growth and skill development.

Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse



Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

Muss

  • Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH)

  • Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich)

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit

  • Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse

Wunsch

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur

title: Senior Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deliverect
description_html:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.

Department Focus:

The Product Department at Deliverect is at the forefront of the digital ordering revolution, dedicated to consistently delivering groundbreaking solutions to the global marketplace. Our team of passionate and innovative engineers, designers, and product managers architect tools that empower businesses to thrive in the evolving digital landscape, streamlining digital ordering for delivery and on-premise services. We are committed to creating user-friendly, dependable, and scalable technology that simplifies operations and enhances customer experiences, playing an integral role in the success of businesses worldwide. In our department, innovation is not just a concept; it's the driving force behind everything we do.

Your Impact:

As a Senior Product Designer for Kiosk, you will end-to-end own and elevate the guest-facing ordering experience across thousands of global restaurant locations. By combining exceptional interaction craft with strong product sense, you will define the product roadmap, design intuitive interfaces, and directly drive key guest funnel outcomes like completion rates, average ticket size, and ordering speed.

This is a contract, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Paris office and 2 days from the comfort of your home.


What you will do:

  • Set the multi-quarter design vision and end-to-end guest experience (approx. 30%): Own every guest-facing touchpoint—attract screen, menu browsing, item customization, upsell, checkout, payment hand-off, confirmation, and edge states—ensuring consumer-grade polish under fixed hardware and fluorescent lighting conditions.

  • Define and own the Kiosk guest product roadmap (approx. 25%): Drive measurable guest-funnel metrics (order completion rate, time-to-order, attach rate, average ticket size, abandonment points) by synthesizing behavioral data, restaurant visits, support insights, and competitive teardowns into prioritized product briefs and sequencing decisions.

  • Prototype, validate, and deliver design-to-code specs (approx. 15%): Build high-fidelity interactive and code-based prototypes to validate flows with real guests before development, delivering detailed specs (tokens, states, motion, accessibility) and conducting design QA on staging builds to enforce the design-code contract.

  • Architect and govern the Kiosk white-label design system (approx. 15%): Design and evolve a multi-tenant system that maintains visual integrity across hundreds of distinct restaurant brand identities, varied hardware types, poor assets, and internationalization standards (European Accessibility Act / WCAG 2.2 and multi-language/RTL layouts).

  • Leverage AI workflows and drive cross-functional leadership (approx. 15%): Supercharge research, spec writing, and ideation using AI tools to accelerate delivery from discovery to ship in weeks; bring engineers, PMs, and commercial leads across global regions to clear decisions; and mentor peer designers through pairing and critique.


    • What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in product design with an outstanding portfolio demonstrating visual craft, interaction design, and product thinking (experience in Kiosk, POS, in-store ordering, checkout, or payments is strongly preferred).

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or equivalent practical work experience.

  • Demonstrated product sense with experience writing briefs, establishing roadmap priorities, running experiments, and driving funnel metrics when operating with or without a dedicated PM.

  • Hands-on experience architecting and scaling complex white-label or multi-brand design systems, including working knowledge of EAA/WCAG accessibility and multi-language/RTL support.

  • Code-aware background with a strong understanding of frontend capabilities, technical logic, and performance constraints to effectively partner with engineers on technical implementation.

  • AI-native mindset, leveraging AI tools as a daily productivity lever for research, ideation, spec creation, and high-fidelity prototyping.

description_html:
Clariness is looking for a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination -  based remotely within Germany.

- Part-time; limited -

About the role: 

As a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination, you will support our Online Marketing team in delivering engaging digital marketing initiatives that connect patients with clinical research opportunities. Working alongside experienced marketing professionals, you'll gain hands-on experience in content creation, digital campaigns, SEO and performance analysis while contributing to meaningful healthcare projects. Because you'll be creating and supporting content for our German-speaking audience, native-level German and fluent English are essential for success in this role.


As a Working Student - Online Marketing Coordination , you would be responsible for:

  • Support the planning, coordination and execution of digital marketing campaigns across multiple online channels.
  • Assist in creating and optimising digital content, including website content, newsletters, landing pages and social media materials.
  • Contribute to SEO initiatives through keyword research, on-page optimisation and website performance monitoring.
  • Monitor campaign performance, compile reports and provide insights to support continuous optimisation.
  • Conduct market, competitor and audience research to help identify opportunities for improving patient recruitment campaigns.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Online Marketing and other internal teams to support shared business objectives.
  • Provide operational and administrative support to the Online Marketing team and assist with additional marketing projects as required.

We would like you to have: 

  • Fluent German language skills (C2) and fluent English (C1/C2).
  • Enrolled at a German university, ideally studying Marketing, Communication Science, Digital Media, or a related field.
  • A basic understanding of digital marketing channels such as Google Ads, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Reddit.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn new digital marketing tools and techniques.
  • An interest in healthcare, clinical trials or the pharmaceutical industry is highly desirable.
  • Previous exposure to digital marketing through internships, university projects or part-time work is advantageous but not essential.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities, including a personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and remote working.
  • Regular team events and an open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Make a meaningful impact on healthcare by helping accelerate access to clinical trials and innovative treatments for patients worldwide.

How to apply & what to expect: 

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Senior Leadership Interview → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step. 

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to

Have we sparked your interest?

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.

Clariness GmbH will treat the above information strictly confidential and will especially observe the applicable provisions of the applicable data protection laws. Further information about the use of the applicant data, you will find in the data protection declaration online at https://www.clariness.com/privacy-policy/

title: Solutions Architect
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Chainalysis
description_html:
Our Solutions Architecture team understands high-level business strategy and translates it into technical requirements for our customers. We love figuring out ways to stretch the limits of what is technically possible. Our job is to provide technical leadership and guidance to customers, prospects, and partners, helping them visualise the steps to achieve their business objectives, and then delivering the outcome with them.

This role spans the whole customer journey. Before the sale, you are the technical lead alongside our Sales team, shaping the solution and earning the technical win. After the sale, you stay with the customer and deliver it, owning the hands-on work that turns a signed contract into a working, adopted capability. You own the outcome, not just the design. When a customer asks a question, you answer it.

As a Solutions Architect, you'll develop a deep understanding of Chainalysis' solutions and offerings, explaining complex topics to a variety of audiences in a compelling yet understandable way. You'll directly impact some of our most strategic private sector customers, and throughout all of these activities you'll provide feedback that improves the value and experience customers have with Chainalysis' solutions.

In this role, you'll:

  • Partner with the Sales team as the technical lead, running discovery, demonstrations, and proofs of value, and leading the discussions on value creation and solution development that achieve the technical win

  • Design customer-specific solutions for the deployment and integration of Chainalysis products, and give guidance on technical challenges ranging from high-level architecture to code implementation

  • Own the post-sale customer experience end to end, configuring, deploying, and tuning our products yourself rather than coordinating others who do it, and working alongside customer teams so they become self-sufficient

  • Drive sustained adoption and measurable value, from fast onboarding through to the ongoing work of monitoring usage, reviewing product health, tuning rules and alerts, and intervening when adoption slips

  • Map customer workflows to capabilities across the product suite, including investigations, compliance, security, and data analysis solutions

  • Investigate using Chainalysis tooling to a competent standard, tracing, attributing, and analysing on the platform, so you can surface actionable insights and integrate Chainalysis into the customer's compliance and risk workflows

  • Be the person customers look to for answers, resolving technical, compliance, analytical, and operational questions directly, and owning time-sensitive decisions by validating signals quickly and moving the right matters through the correct escalation path

  • Communicate and translate complex technical requirements to our Product and Engineering teams, including data gaps such as unclustered or unattributed services that you find in the field

  • Become a trusted technical advisor to both internal and external customers, identifying business opportunities and substantially increasing our foothold with private sector customers and prospects

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • Worked in or directly with our private sector customer types: banks, cryptocurrency exchanges, payment processors, and blockchain developers

  • Practical understanding of compliance, investigative, and risk workflows, and can speak credibly from practitioner experience in investigations, compliance, fraud, risk, or security

  • A technical generalist background, comfortable with REST API integrations and familiar with how data is structured in SQL, and always interested in learning more

  • Experience of account or customer management for an enterprise SaaS business, including commercial awareness and partnering with sales counterparts on renewals and expansion

  • The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and executive audiences

  • Curiosity, fast learning, and motivation to solve difficult customer problems

  • A collaborative approach and generosity with knowledge

  • Fluency in English

Nice to have experience:

  • Financial compliance and anti-money laundering obligations

  • Proficiency in Python, REST API integrations, and SQL databases

  • Hands-on use of AI tooling to improve delivery quality or speed

  • Experience handling sensitive data and proprietary methods, and protecting them while using them effectively

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Omaze
description_html:
Senior Platform Engineer

🌍 Location: Holborn, London

⭐ Office Policy: Hybrid: 3 days a week in office

Who We Are

At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £120 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

Why You’ll Love Working at Omaze

  • Growth: Omaze is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world.

  • Impact: Join a team of world changers dedicated to creating a ripple effect of good.

  • Pioneering: Be part of something no one has done before.

  • Culture: We work hard, grow together, and spread joy along the way.

🔑 About The Job

As a Senior Platform Engineer at Omaze, you take genuine ownership of the infrastructure and reliability foundations that everything else depends on. You're experienced across AWS, particularly Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB and the serverless patterns that underpin our platform. You know how to build and maintain infrastructure that's secure, observable, cost-efficient at scale and globally distributed. You work in code - IaC isn't an afterthought for you, it's how you think. You bring the kind of judgement that comes from having run production systems under real pressure, and you apply that same rigour to the developer experience because a platform team that makes engineers faster is a force multiplier for the whole organisation.

🔧 What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the design, implementation, and evolution of Omaze's cloud infrastructure on AWS, Lambda, API Gateway, and surrounding services, written and maintained as code using CDK and / or Terraform.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions that are fast, reliable, and give engineers confidence to ship frequently and safely.

  • Drive observability across the platform via instrumentation, alerting, dashboards, and on-call tooling so the team can detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents quickly.

  • Own security and compliance posture across the infrastructure: IAM, secrets management, network boundaries, and regulatory requirements, identifying risk early and remediating it properly.

  • Identify and act on cost optimisation opportunities, tracking resource utilisation, rightsizing infrastructure, and making spend visible and understandable across engineering.

  • Raise the baseline for developer experience by reducing toil, improving deployment workflows, and making the right way to do things the easy way.

  • Hold a high bar in infrastructure code review by giving feedback that's direct, constructive, and focused on long-term maintainability and security.

  • Use AI-assisted tooling as a natural part of your workflow and apply the same rigour and judgement to AI-generated infrastructure code as you would to anything hand-written.

🤩 About You

  • Significant experience as a Platform, Infrastructure, or DevOps engineer, with a strong AWS background and hands-on serverless experience (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, event-driven architectures).

  • Production-grade IaC experience with Terraform and/or AWS CDK. You write infrastructure the same way you write application code: tested, reviewed, and version controlled.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, particularly GitHub Actions, and a track record of improving deployment reliability and developer velocity.

  • Deep familiarity with observability tooling and incident response practices. You've been on-call and know what good looks like.

  • Solid understanding of cloud security principles: IAM, least privilege, secrets management, network security, and compliance requirements in regulated environments.

  • Experience tracking and optimising cloud costs. You understand the levers and know how to make trade-offs without compromising reliability.

  • Comfortable working closely with other engineering teams translating infrastructure complexity into clear patterns and guardrails teams can follow confidently.

  • A clear communicator who can make the case for the platform as a product investment to both technical and non-technical audiences.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

Diversity statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

description_html:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

title: Founding Commercial SDR - London
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at BLP Digital AG
description_html:
Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK and USA. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

What the job actually feels like

Most SDR jobs end when the meeting gets booked. This one starts there. You'll hear "no" ten times before you hear "yes." That "yes" is a 30-minute discovery call with a CFO, CPO or CIO at a Fortune 500 manufacturer, where you run the meeting, present the value proposition, and build the stakeholder map live. The Senior SDRs who win here treat every "no" as a data point and every "yes" as a chair at the table.

 

About the role

As a Founding Commercial Sales Development Representative, you will own the outreach into Commercial manufacturing and industrial accounts. You'll work closely with our Sales team to prospect and nurture relationships with CFO, CPO, CEO and CIO stakeholders, and drive sales opportunities for our Agentic AI platform automating Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash. You will have a proactive approach and work to accelerate the sales process, convert leads into qualified opportunities, and consistently hit sales targets.

 

Tech stack

You will work with a sharp outbound stack: HubSpot as our CRM and source of truth, Clay for enrichment and signal-based prospecting, Claude for AI assisted tasks and research, and LinkMatch to keep LinkedIn and HubSpot in sync without manual logging.

 

What you'll do

  • Take ownership of strategic outreach into Commercial manufacturing and industrial accounts through cold calls and personalized messages, engaging CFO, CPO, CEO and CIO stakeholders.

  • Craft tailored value propositions by understanding the unique pain points of stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, and IT in Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash processes.

  • Prospect large accounts and build multi-threaded stakeholder maps across Finance, Procurement, IT and the executive sponsor.

  • Run and present in 30-minute discovery calls with C-level stakeholders. You own the meeting, not just the booking.

  • Stay ahead of the market by continuously updating your commercial knowledge, analysing procurement and finance processes, and tracking industry trends in Agentic AI and ERP automation.

  • Prioritise complex tasks with clients, flagging bottlenecks early rather than late to keep things moving forward.

  • Carry a quota of 1.2M ARR closed-won sourced per year.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 2-4 years of experience in a B2B SaaS sales environment, ideally selling into manufacturing, industrial or finance/procurement buyers, and a track record of building stakeholder maps in commercial accounts while consistently exceeding sales targets.

  • You communicate clearly, concisely, and persuasively, with the ability to adapt your style to a CFO, CPO, CEO or CIO conversation.

  • You handle rejection with resilience and keep your momentum through long, multi-stakeholder commercial sales cycles.

  • You're a team player with a sense of ownership and accountability.

  • You enjoy problem-solving and have a natural curiosity that drives you to find creative solutions.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience selling into Manufacturing, Industrial or Finance/procurement buyers, are familiar with ERP systems or sales tech such as Hubspot and Claude.

 

What you'll get

  • Training and development. Enjoy a 3-month onboarding process with ongoing support to set you up for success.

  • Fair lead allocation. We make sure the playing field is level for everyone. AI algorithms decide, not managers.

  • High earning potential. Uncapped commission and expected 6-figure package, and opportunity to participate in common share equity program.

  • Equal OTEs. As we share the same incentives, you'll be comped as the Account Executives.

  • Flexible locations. Zurich, Munich, Cologne, London. Come work in one of our offices. If you are not based in Zurich, you are welcome to visit your colleagues regularly.

  • Opportunities to grow. You're controlling your personal development and career trajectory in a rapidly growing, internationally expanding startup.

  • Exceptional colleagues. You'll be growing alongside individuals from exceptional academic backgrounds and careers.

 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

description_html:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As a Front-End Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Marketing Manager - Manda
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at iwoca
description_html:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We're looking for a Marketing Manager to own how business owners find manda, iwoca's M&A platform. You'll be our first marketing hire, joining as we open the platform to business owners who don't yet bank with iwoca. Almost everything about how we reach them is still to be decided, and you'll be the one deciding it.

The team

You'll be our first marketing hire, joining a founding team of circa 10 mandans. All highly motivated to finally free the SME M&A space from the lack of meaningful innovation in the space.

You'll get the autonomy and pace of a startup, with the data, infrastructure and credibility of an established lender behind you. You'll report directly into the Venture Lead of manda.

Your mission

Your mission is to bring the right business owners to manda: people genuinely thinking about selling, at the point in their lives when they're thinking about it.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but it doesn't scale and the pool is finite. Your job is to build the channels that reach owners who have never heard of iwoca, work out which of those channels produce real mandates at a cost our fee model can support, and shut down the ones that don't.

You won't be inheriting a growth engine. We're launching our direct application journey this autumn, and filling it is your first job. You'll be building the first growth engine here, and you'll be the person who decides where the money goes.

The role

Find the channels that work

  • Run cheap, fast tests across direct channels such as paid search, paid social, organic, and direct response. Prioritise those that work and kill the ones that don't, based on evidence.

  • Own the budget and the allocation decisions. You'll start small on purpose: we'd rather learn which channel works than spend heavily on one that doesn't.

  • Write and test the copy yourself, from ads to landing pages, and iterate on what real business owners actually respond to.

  • Test offline as well as digital. Mail and email direct to business owners are two of the few ways to reach someone who isn't actively searching for a way out, and nobody has tested either properly for us yet.

  • Earn coverage in the trade press. We have real deals to talk about now, and working with iwoca's comms team you should be able to turn them into a steady source of inbound interest.

Prove the unit economics

  • Establish what it actually costs us to acquire a seller mandate through each channel. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it — replacing it with a real number is one of the most valuable things you can do in your first six months.

  • Define how we value a lead before it becomes a deal. Our conversion event is months away from first contact and worth a lot when it lands, so you'll need a sensible proxy to steer spend against.

Build the measurement first

  • Set up attribution, with needed tech support, so that customers can be traced back to the channel that produced them.

  • Build the reporting that tells the team which channels are working, and be the person who questions a number that looks too good.

Turn our website into something that converts

  • Make the case for manda clearly: what the process involves, how long each step takes, and why we're different from a traditional broker.

  • Use our completed deals, our team's track record and our acquisition finance offering as proof, and test what actually persuades a cautious owner to start a conversation about selling.

Help us reach better buyers

  • Sellers come first, but manda is a two-sided market. Once seller supply is working, you'll help us reach acquirers who are serious, credible and ready to transact, including buyers who are new to iwoca.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in acquisition, growth or generalist marketing, ideally in a startup, scale-up or new venture where you had to work out what to do rather than execute someone else's plan.

  • M&A, marketplace or two-sided experience, especially where supply rather than demand was the constraint.

  • Comfortable with a long, low-frequency, high-value conversion. Selling a business is nothing like taking out a loan: the cycle runs for months, volumes are low, and you'll have to make decisions on thin and noisy data without waiting for statistical comfort.

  • Numerate and data-literate. You build the measurement before the campaign, you can read a funnel, and you're happy owning the numbers you report.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team and no agency to hide behind: you'll write the copy, brief the page, set up the tracking and pull the reporting yourself.

  • Experience driving applications or sign-ups into a live product journey, and comfortable working with product and engineering on the conversion steps you don't own yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience marketing to owner-managers of established SMEs, particularly around retirement, succession or exit.

  • You've personally owned a paid channel with a real budget, and you've killed one that wasn't working. We care as much about the second part as the first.

  • Regulated or financial services marketing experience.

  • Offline direct response experience, particularly direct mail.

  • Hands-on with HubSpot, GA4 or similar, and comfortable with SQL or a BI tool like Looker.

The salary

We expect to pay from £55,000–£80,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. title: Partnerships Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at iwoca
description_html:
The company

It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction values make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. A generation of owner-managers is approaching retirement, and most of them have no realistic route to a sale.

manda exists to fix that. We match buyers with sellers in the part of the market everyone else ignores, and we finance acquisitions ourselves so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. We've sold the first businesses, funded the first acquisition loans, and we're now opening the platform up beyond the businesses that already bank with us.

manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders. Since 2012 iwoca has provided more than £4 billion in funding and its mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments. That backing is why we can serve this market where others can't: a deep footprint in the SME economy with 150,000+ UK customers, the data and infrastructure of an established lender, and the ability to build clean, automated processes instead of running an advisory firm on spreadsheets.

We’re looking for a Partnership Manager - manda (iwoca's M&A Platform)

We're looking for someone to build the introducer network that brings business owners to manda, iwoca's M&A platform. Accountants, solicitors, wealth managers and brokers meet an owner who is thinking about retiring long before we do. Your job is to make sure that when they do they think of us, and that referring us is the easiest thing they do that day.

The role

Your mission is to build a referral channel that produces a steady flow of business owners who are genuinely ready to sell.

Today almost all of our sellers come from iwoca's own customer base, found by hand and worked one at a time. That works, but the pool is finite. The professionals who already advise business owners are the most credible route to the ones we'd otherwise never reach, and right now we have no systematic way of working with them.

You'll be starting from close to nothing, so the first version of this channel is yours to design. It also means the job is as much about making referrals actually arrive as it is about signing partners up.

It also has to scale. In this industry most partner flow still depends on people turning up at industry events, which works but stops the moment you stop showing up. We're after the version of this channel where referring a client to manda takes a couple of clicks inside the software an adviser already uses.

Key responsibilities include:

Build the introducer network

  • Find and win the firms worth working with: accountancy practices, corporate finance boutiques, solicitors, wealth managers and business transfer agents. Work out which kinds of firm actually refer, and concentrate there.

  • Do the outbound yourself. Identify the firm, get the meeting, make the case, and follow up until something happens.

  • Design what we offer them: how a referral is made, what the partner gets, what we commit to in return, and how we keep them informed once their client is with us.

Make referrals actually arrive

  • A signed partnership is worth nothing until a referral comes through. You'll own the ongoing relationship work that turns agreements into a flow: regular contact, keeping manda front of mind, briefing partner teams, and being the person they call.

  • Track referral volume and quality by partner, and be honest about which relationships aren't working so we can stop spending time on them.

Make the channel scale

  • Judge every partnership by whether it adds referrals without adding work. A relationship that only produces when you're in the room isn't a channel yet.

  • Work out which partner technology is worth plugging into: the practice management and accounting software advisers already work in, tracked referral links and partner portals, and integrations that let a firm refer a client without leaving their own tools. You won't build these yourself, but you'll identify them, make the commercial case, and scope them with our Product Builder.

  • Look for partners who can bring a book rather than one client at a time. One firm with hundreds of owner-managed clients is worth more to us than ten firms with five, if we can find a way to surface the right candidates across the whole book.

Work iwoca's existing network

  • iwoca already has a broker network and a partnerships function with relationships across the SME economy. Working out where manda fits into those relationships is far faster than starting cold, and it's the first place to look.

Events and community

  • Build a focused programme of events worth attending and, where it makes sense, running our own: succession and exit planning, accountancy and adviser events, industry gatherings, and business owner peer communities.

  • Judge them on referrals rather than attendance, and stop going to the ones that don't produce. Events are how you find and land partners, not how the channel scales.

Prove the channel pays

  • Establish what a referral actually costs us once your time, any partner incentives and events are counted, and how many convert into a signed mandate. We have an assumption in our financial model and nobody has yet tested it.

The requirements

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and who are always looking to improve.

Essential:

  • Around 4+ years in partnerships, channel or business development, ideally B2B, where you built or substantially grew a referral channel rather than inheriting one that already worked.

  • You've done the full cycle yourself: identified the target firms, got the meetings, agreed the terms, and then managed the relationship afterwards.

  • A background in M&A, marketplaces, business broking or business transfer.

  • You understand that the work starts after the agreement is signed, and you have the discipline to keep a channel warm over months rather than weeks.

  • Numerate and honest about performance. You track referrals by partner, you know which relationships are producing, and you say so when one isn't.

  • You think in systems as well as relationships. You can tell the difference between a partnership that scales and one that only works while you're pushing it, and you'd rather replace your own manual work with an integration than defend it.

  • Comfortable specifying technology without building it. You can look at a partner's tools and our product, work out what would make us the path of least resistance, and scope it clearly enough for a product team to build.

  • Genuinely hands-on. There's no team to delegate to: you'll build the target list, send the emails, run the meetings and keep the CRM straight yourself.

  • A commercial thinker with a bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture.

Bonus:

  • Experience with accountancy, legal or wealth management channels specifically.

  • Experience running an event programme with commercial targets attached to it.

  • Familiarity with the UK succession and exit planning landscape.

  • Comfortable treating a CRM as a discipline rather than an afterthought, ideally HubSpot.

  • You've shipped a partner integration, an embedded referral flow or a software marketplace listing, or worked closely with a product team on one.

  • Familiar with the software UK accountancy practices and advisers actually work in, such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, IRIS or Dext.

The salary

We expect to pay £55,000–£80,000 and an annual performance based bonus for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

description_html:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

We are looking for a seasoned IT Engineer II to join our Engineering team. At this level, you have developed your skill set to confidently tackle all but the most complex problems affecting the team. You will lead the delivery of essential IT services and small to medium-sized projects, either independently or by guiding other engineers.

 

As an Engineer II, you are an individual contributor with a deep understanding of your team’s purpose and how it impacts Checkout as a whole. You will act as an owner-operator, taking accountability for the success of the systems within your area of responsibility.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Project Leadership: Independently design and deliver project-level work with minimal guidance from senior engineers.

  • Atlassian Mastery: Act as a subject matter expert for our Workplace Technology stack, with a specific focus on high-level administration and optimisation of Jira and Confluence.

  • Endpoint & Infrastructure: Provide advanced technical support and policy management for macOS and Windows endpoints using Jamf and Microsoft Intune.

  • Operational Excellence: Provide an advanced level of operational support on team-owned services and train new members on service design, security, and operations.

  • Incident Response: Display urgency and accountability during incidents, triaging and supporting complex flows unaided.

  • Mentorship: Regularly support and mentor less experienced engineers, helping to raise the technical quality of the team.

  • Automation: Proactively recognise areas for improvement and suggest automated solutions (Python/PowerShell) to reduce incidental complexity.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Typically 2–3+ years of experience in an IT Engineering or similar technical role.

  • Technical Expertise: Experience with Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD) and protocols like SAML and SCIM.

  • Advanced Atlassian Skills: High-level experience managing the Atlassian suite. You should be comfortable with complex Jira configurations, workflow customisations, and permission schemes.

  • Problem Solving: A logical approach to troubleshooting, with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs between different solutions.

  • Ownership: A proactive "owner-operator" mindset—you take responsibility for your tasks and the long-term health of the systems you manage.

  • Communication: Ability to communicate effectively with company stakeholders and resolve complex support queries within your area of focus.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where you can balance temporary workarounds with flexible, long-term architectural solutions.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

description_html:
Die noris network AG steht für innovative, sichere und nachhaltige IT-Lösungen. Mit über 600 engagierten Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir leistungsstarke Services in den Bereichen Cloud, Datacenter, Network & Security sowie Managed Applications – betrieben auf einer hochmodernen, mehrfach zertifizierten IT-Infrastruktur mit eigenen Hochsicherheitsrechenzentren. Seit 1993 sind wir kontinuierlich gewachsen und zählen heute zu den führenden IT-Spezialisten in Deutschland. Unser größtes Kapital? Ein starkes, diverses Team mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mitzugestalten. Deshalb fördern wir Eigenverantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und frische Ideen – in einem Umfeld, das Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit vereint.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb Dich an unseren Standorten in Nürnberg, Aschheim, Berlin oder remote (innerhalb Deutschlands).

Unser Team Product & Solution Design entwickelt und dokumentiert die technischen Konzepte für die Implementierung und die nachfolgende Integration von Lösungen und Produkten (Services) in den Betrieb und berät die Kunden in Bezug auf Designfragen ihrer IT-Landschaft.

Aufgaben

  • Steuerung der technischen Entwicklung von Produkten (IT-Services) auf der Plattform- und Applikationsebene
  • Sehr enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Produktmanagement im Rahmen von Angebotsprozessen
  • Strukturierte Einbindung der fachspezifischen Technik-Teams und Systemarchitekten sowie externer Partner
  • Mitarbeit bei der technologischen Weiterentwicklung zentraler Betriebsplattformen
  • Technische Beratung von Kunden (branchenübergreifend) zu Lösungsplattformen
  • Erstellung von Design Guides und Blueprints sowie Coaching von KollegInnen zu technologischen Fragen

Qualifikation

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Weitreichende Erfahrung in der technischen Umsetzung von IT-Projekten und im IT-Betrieb
  • Erfahrung in der praktischen Anwendung von mehreren Technologien
  • Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von rechenzentrumsnahen IT-Services, hohe Kundenorientierung und Qualitätsbewusstsein
  • Zielorientierung und kreative Lösungskompetenz sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Repräsentationsfähigkeit
  • Selbstständige, eigenverantwortliche und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit und unternehmerisches Handeln
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Arbeiten an verschiedenen Standorten möglich (z.B. Nürnberg, Aschheim, Berlin) oder auch zu 100% Remote
  • Hochwertiges Equipment: Laptop und Firmenhandy auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Individuelle Förderung und Weiterentwicklung durch Inhouse-Trainings und externe Schulungen
  • Kinderbetreuungskostenzuschuss (pro Monat/Kind) und Corporate Benefits
  • Attraktive Firmenevents (inkl. Reisekostenübernahme), kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie Duz-Kultur ab dem ersten Tag
  • Großzügiger Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket
  • Gesundheitsmanagement (z.B. kostenlose Massagen inhouse), Jobrad Leasing und betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Zuschuss
  • Welcome Day, direkter Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) und strukturierte Einarbeitungsphase
  • Getränke for free (auch Softdrinks) und frisches Obst an den Standorten
