title: Senior Fullstack Developer – Business Automation (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Metergrid
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir verantworten u.a. das zentrale CRM HubSpot, über das alle Prozesse unserer Wertschöpfungskette laufen. Interne Software-Produkte integrieren sich genauso in unsere CRM-Infrastruktur wie spezifische Apps, z.B. zur Terminbuchung bei einer Kundenanfrage. Der nächste Skalierungs-Schritt erfordert einen noch stärkeren Fokus auf technisches Enablement unserer eigenen Organisation sowie den Ausbau und die Verbesserung unseres eigenen technischen Verantwortungsbereichs.

Du übernimmst dabei eine gewachsene, produktive Automatisierungslandschaft: Ein Teil unserer Geschäftslogik läuft heute als Custom Code direkt in HubSpot-Workflows, ein Teil in eigenen Backend-Services. Beides gehört dir – und du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich diese Architektur entwickelt.

Softwareentwicklung

  • Entwicklung TypeScript-basierter Automatisierungen und Services entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette im HubSpot CRM

  • Entwicklung von HubSpot-Apps und UI Extensions (React) für unsere internen Teams – von CRM-Cards bis Workflow-Actions

  • Verwaltung von Scopes, Token-Rotation, App-Versionierung und Deployments (CI/CD)

Automatisierungen & Workflows

  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von Custom-Code-Automatisierungen, die als Teil von HubSpot-Workflows laufen – inklusive Pflege der Workflows selbst (Trigger, Enrollment-Kriterien, Fehlerbilder)

  • Bewusste Platzierung von Logik: Du entscheidest, was in einen Workflow gehört, was in Custom Code und was in einen Backend-Service – und migrierst Logik dorthin, wo sie testbar und wartbar ist

  • Analyse und Behebung von Incidents in der bestehenden Automatisierungslandschaft, inklusive Datenkorrekturen und Backfills per Skript

API- & Event-getriebene Architektur

  • Einsatz der HubSpot CRM APIs für Objekte, Assoziationen und Batch-Operationen

  • Nutzung von Webhooks & Subscriptions für Event-getriebene Synchronisation

  • Aufbau robuster Retry-, Error-Handling- und Monitoring-Mechanismen – inklusive bewusstem Umgang mit Rate-Limits und Datenvolumen

Datenmodellierung & CRM-Architektur

  • Definition von Objektbeziehungen, Ownership-Logiken und Lifecycle-Zuständen

  • Sicherstellung von Datenkonsistenz über mehrere Systeme hinweg

Integrationen & Plattform-Strategie

  • Technische Anbindung interner sowie externer Systeme (z.B. Abrechnung, Metering, Energie-Backends, eigener Tech Stack)

  • Aufbau sauberer Schnittstellen zwischen HubSpot und produktiven Kernsystemen

  • Aktive Mitgestaltung der langfristigen CRM- & Integrationsarchitektur – inklusive der schrittweisen Verlagerung komplexer Geschäftslogik aus Workflows in testbare Backend-Services



Dein Profil

Software-Engineering

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen, mit klarem Schwerpunkt Backend

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript; solide React-Kenntnisse für unsere CRM-Cards und UI Extensions (NestJS ist ein Plus)

  • Erfahrung mit REST-APIs, asynchronen Systemen, Queues und Event-Verarbeitung

  • Verständnis für saubere API-Verträge, Versionierung und Testing – du weißt, wann ein Pattern hilft und wann es Zeremonie ist

Systemdenken: Automatisierung & Skalierung

title: Engineering Manager (m/w/d) – Core Team
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Metergrid
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir bauen die Software, mit der Mieterstromprojekte laufen: Zählerdaten rein, Abrechnung raus, und alles dazwischen. Das Core Team verantwortet das Betreiberportal, das Produkt, auf dem der laufende Betrieb unserer Kunden steht. Es ist unser fachlich tiefstes Team, und es wächst.

Das Betreiberportal ist kein generisches SaaS. Es bildet die Energiewirtschaft ab: Messstellenbetrieb, Marktkommunikation, Netzentgelte, Umlagen, Abrechnung nach Regeln, die der Gesetzgeber schreibt und regelmäßig ändert. Wer hier priorisiert, muss verstehen, was eine Anforderung für den Betreiber wirtschaftlich bedeutet und was passiert, wenn sie falsch umgesetzt wird.

Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die das Team führt und das Geschäft dahinter versteht. Nicht als Durchreiche für Tickets und nicht als Architekt, der alles selbst entscheidet, sondern als jemand, der Business-Anforderungen in technische Entscheidungen übersetzt und dafür sorgt, dass gute Entwickler gute Arbeit machen können: klare Ziele, wenig Reibung, ehrliches Feedback, verlässliche Lieferung.

Der Weg dahin ist bewusst gewählt: Du startest für rund sechs Monate als Entwickler im Core Team. Du baust Features, machst Reviews und lernst Codebasis, Fachlichkeit und Menschen von innen kennen. Danach übernimmst du die Führung des Teams. Wer ein Team führen will, das er nie von innen gesehen hat, führt es an dem vorbei, was zählt.

Technisch: Python mit Django und Django Ninja im Backend, React mit TypeScript im Frontend, PostgreSQL mit TimescaleDB, deployt auf Kubernetes per GitOps mit ArgoCD. KI-Coding-Assistenten sind fester Teil des Workflows. In den ersten Monaten schreibst du diesen Code selbst. Danach musst du ihn weiter lesen können und verstehen, worüber dein Team diskutiert.

In den ersten sechs Monaten

  • Du arbeitest als Entwickler im Core Team: Features end-to-end, Reviews, Deployments, Support-Fälle. Ohne Sonderrolle

  • Du lernst die Fachlichkeit von Messkonzept bis Abrechnung und die Geschichte der Codebasis, inklusive der Stellen, an denen sie weh tut

  • Du baust Vertrauen zu den Menschen im Team auf, weil du mit ihnen arbeitest und nicht über ihnen

Danach

  • Du führst das Core Team: Einstellung, Onboarding, 1:1s, Entwicklung, Feedback. Die Menschen im Team sind deine erste Verantwortung

  • Du verantwortest die Lieferung: Zusammen mit Product priorisierst du nach wirtschaftlichem Wert und regulatorischem Druck, planst realistisch und sorgst dafür, dass Zugesagtes fertig wird

  • Du bringst Fachverständnis in die Produktentscheidungen ein: Du erkennst, wann eine Anforderung aus dem Markt kommt, wann aus einem einzelnen Kunden, und wann aus einem Missverständnis

  • Du hältst die technische Qualität hoch, ohne selbst der Flaschenhals zu sein: Du moderierst Architekturentscheidungen, forderst Tests und Reviews ein und schaffst Raum für Refactoring

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zu Product, Support und den anderen Engineering-Teams, und du löst Konflikte, bevor sie im Sprint landen

  • Du machst Probleme sichtbar: Wenn etwas nicht klappt, sagst du es früh und mit Vorschlag statt spät und mit Ausrede

  • Du gestaltest Prozesse so, dass sie dem Team dienen, und schaffst die ab, die es nicht tun


Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung als Softwareentwickler mit Web-Anwendungen in Produktion. Du kannst in Django und React produktiv arbeiten oder dich in wenigen Wochen dort einfinden

  • Erfahrung in der Führung eines Entwicklungsteams, als Engineering Manager, Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit Personalverantwortung

  • Du kannst ein Datenmodell beurteilen und eine Architekturdiskussion moderieren, ohne sie an dich zu reißen

  • Du willst wieder oder weiter Code schreiben, bevor du führst, und siehst das als Vorteil, nicht als Umweg

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft, idealerweise in Messstellenbetrieb, Abrechnung, Marktkommunikation oder Mieterstrom. Du kennst Begriffe wie Messkonzept, MaLo oder OBIS nicht nur aus Wikipedia

  • Business-Verständnis: Du denkst vom Geschäftsmodell des Betreibers her, nicht vom Feature. Du kannst erklären, welche Anforderung Umsatz sichert, welche Risiko reduziert und welche nur schön ist

  • Du gibst direktes Feedback und hältst es aus, direktes Feedback zu bekommen

  • Du kannst Nein sagen, zu Stakeholdern und zum eigenen Team, und begründen, warum

  • Du fühlst dich in einem Startup wohl, in dem Strukturen noch entstehen und du sie mitgestaltest

  • Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, weil Fachlichkeit, Kunden und ein Großteil der Kommunikation deutsch sind


Warum wir?

  • Eine Führungsrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einer wachsenden Engineering-Organisation, mit einem Einstieg, der dich nicht ins kalte Wasser wirft

  • Direkter Draht zum CTO und Mitsprache bei der Teamstruktur, nicht nur bei der Umsetzung

  • Hybrid in Hamburg: 1-2 Tage im Office, der Rest remote

  • Ein Team ohne Hierarchieebenen. Wer eine bessere Idee hat, setzt sie um

  • Zuschuss zu Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing, Urban Sports Club und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge

  • Ein Produkt, das die Energiewende konkret voranbringt, statt sie nur in die Präsentation zu schreiben

title: Senior Product Developer – Candy & Confectionery (All Genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Ahead Gmbh
description_html:
YOU & AHEAD

At ahead, we are on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We make the snacks everyone actually craves: chocolate bars, protein bars, wafers, cookies, gummies and more. Our products contain up to 90% less sugar with zero compromise on taste. We are a 130-person team based in Hamburg, with our own lab, a portfolio of more than 170 SKUs and ambitious growth plans across D2C, retail, Amazon and Europe.

We are looking for a Senior Product Developer for Candy & Confectionery to own the technical development of our portfolio from the first brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up and launch.

As our Senior Product Developer, you will bring technical depth to one of our most important categories and make sure every decision works in the real world: in the recipe, in the factory and in the customer’s hands.

Are you a food developer who knows how to turn a great idea into a product people genuinely love? Someone who can balance taste, texture, stability, cost, compliance and timing while getting the product over the line? If you like taking ownership and enjoy solving real product problems, we would love to hear from you! 


YOUR TASKS

  • End-to-End Product Development: You own candy and confectionery projects from brief to launch. You translate requirements into clear technical targets, develop and optimise formulations, oversee trials, sensory validation and technical decisions.

  • Sugar Reduction & Product Performance: You develop reduced-sugar and no-added-sugar products without compromising on taste. You understand how ingredients affect texture, processing, stability and shelf life, and make clear trade-offs between quality, cost, compliance and speed.

  • Sensory, Shelf Life & Scale-Up: You plan and coordinate sensory, shelf-life and stability testing. You prepare for pilot and industrial trials, work closely with co-manufacturers, troubleshoot issues and follow solutions through to production.

  • Specifications, Suppliers & Compliance: You manage formulations, specifications, technical documentation, ingredients and samples. Together with our Quality team, you ensure that food law, labelling, allergen, nutritional and claims requirements are considered from the start.

  • Cross-Functional Ownership: You work closely with Product, Quality, Operations, Procurement, Brand, Retail and Marketing. You communicate clearly, flag risks early, challenge assumptions and keep projects moving.

  • Building Better NPD Processes: You document decisions and learnings, create clear handovers and help make product development more structured and predictable as ahead grows.


YOUR PROFILE

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in food product development, R&D, or NPD, with a track record from brief through formulation, sensory validation, scale-up, and launch. Hands-on experience in gummies, candy, chocolate, confectionery, or a related sweet-goods category is mandatory.

  • You understand how taste, texture, processing, stability, shelf life, ingredients and production realities come together in a successful product. You have experience with sugar-reduction or no-added-sugar systems and know how to balance product performance with consumer expectations.

  • You have worked with ingredient suppliers and co-manufacturers and have been involved in pilot or industrial-scale production. You are comfortable with specifications, technical documentation, and food-law requirements.

  • You take ownership and follow through. You are structured without being bureaucratic, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to challenge a brief, assumption or timeline when needed. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy working as a senior individual contributor without direct reports initially.

  • You hold a degree or equivalent training in food science, food technology, chemistry, nutrition science, ecotrophology, or a comparable field. You communicate confidently in German and English.


WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE

  • Experience launching 10+ food products, ideally across multiple markets.

  • Experience working with gummies, candy, chocolate bars, cookies, filled confectionery or similar products.

  • Strong knowledge of sugar reduction, sweetener systems, fibres and texture management.

  • Experience planning, conducting or interpreting sensory tests, shelf-life studies and stability testing.

  • Background in better-for-you food, functional food, private-label NPD, or a fast-growing consumer brand.

  • Experience delivering products into D2C and retail channels across DACH or Europe.


AND WHY AHEAD?

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together.

  • Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose
  • Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along
  • Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together
  • Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities
  • Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more)
  • Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve)
  • Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget
This role is based in Hamburg, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week and the option to work from abroad for agreed upon periods. If this resonates with you, we're excited to go ahead with you!


Disclaimer

ahead GmbH is an equal opportunity workplace and is devoted to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

YOUR TASKS

  • Du verantwortest dein eigenes Vertriebsgebiet und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte in den Regalen der Lebensmittelmärkte bestens platziert sind.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel und kennst dich in der Branche aus.
  • Du bist kontaktfreudig und selbstbewusst und liebst es, neue Kontakte zu knüpfen.

AND WHY AHEAD?

  • Großartiges Produkt: Unsere Low Sugar Snacks sind einfach richtig lecker. Hast du schon probiert?
  • Coole Benefits: Unser Büro liegt im Herzen Hamburgs! Du hast die Möglichkeit für Home Office (2 Tage pro Woche) und viele andere Vorteile wie Macbook, Merch, Snacks und Getränke gibts inklusive.
  • Team-Offsites: Jedes Jahr machen wir mit dem Team coole Offsites und wir planen bereits unser nächstes Abenteuer. Schließe dich uns an und erlebe unvergessliche Offsites mit dem Team!


YOUR NEXT STEPS WITH US

Cool! Dann los. So sieht der Bewerbungsprozess aus:
Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Gründe, warum du bei ahead dabei sein willst.

title: Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager
description_html:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We’re looking for a Digital Customer Success Campaign Manager to design, launch, and improve digital customer journeys at scale. You’ll turn customer and product signals into timely, useful programs that help customers move from trial through activation, adoption, and ongoing value. This is a hands-on, program-focused role for someone who enjoys combining thoughtful communication, data, experimentation, and emerging technology.

Reporting into the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success, this role is based remotely in North America, with hiring locations in the United States or Canada.

How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

What we're looking for:

• Bring experience in Digital Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Growth Operations, Customer Success Operations, or Product-led Growth within a Software as a Service (SaaS) environment.

• Have owned or significantly contributed to lifecycle or digital customer programs with measurable impact.

• Write clear, engaging customer-facing communications and adapt messaging for different audiences and customer needs.

• Interpret customer and product usage data, identify patterns, and turn insights into practical campaign and journey improvements.

• Work effectively across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Data, Operations, and Content teams while navigating changing priorities and building new programs from the ground up.


Bonus points for:
• Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) tools to accelerate campaign development, analysis, experimentation, or content creation.

• Experience with 1Password, cybersecurity, or a similar technology product.

What you can expect:

• Design, launch, and continuously improve digital customer journeys across onboarding, activation, adoption, expansion, and renewal.

• Develop targeted campaigns that help customers move from trial to meaningful product adoption and guide them toward the right next step.

• Draft, edit, and optimize customer-facing email campaigns, connecting them with education resources and other digital experiences.

• Use customer signals, milestones, and behaviors to identify moments of friction or opportunity and create timely interventions.

• Monitor campaign performance through metrics such as engagement, activation, product usage, retention, and expansion; use experimentation and cohort analysis to improve results.

• Partner with Data and Analytics teams to support dashboards and reporting, then use those insights to make informed recommendations.

• Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Content partners to keep programs accurate, useful, and aligned with the customer journey.

• Use tools such as Gainsight, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, and AI solutions to increase campaign quality, testing speed, and operational efficiency.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building in an evolving environment, can work independently through ambiguity, and is motivated by creating scalable customer experiences that help more people get value from 1Password.


USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $96,000 USD and $134,000 USD. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.
Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $88,000 CAD and $123,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.
You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.
How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.
Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.
For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.
Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.
What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:
Health and wellbeing
Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
Competitive health benefits
Generous PTO policy
Growth and future
RSU program for most employees
Retirement matching program
Free 1Password account
Community
Paid volunteer days
Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. See here for the latest third party bias audit information. If you prefer not to have your application assessed using AI/ML features, you may opt out by completing this form. For additional information see our Candidate Privacy Notice.

description_html:
🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
  • A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
  • A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
  • Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
  • A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here!
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

The Mission 🪐
  • The Situation: Malt is cementing its position as the undeniable leader in the European freelance economy. While our tech-powered platform connects over 1,000,000 top-tier freelancers with 100,000+ companies, the DACH Enterprise sector presents a massive, untapped frontier. This market is dominated by complex, multinational corporate structures with deeply entrenched procurement protocols that are ripe for disruption.
  • The Task: We are not hiring you to manage an existing portfolio or farm warm leads. You are being brought in to architect and own the zero-to-one enterprise acquisition strategy for the DACH region. Operating as the "founder" of your territory, your mandate is to systematically penetrate massive global accounts, navigate labyrinthine procurement structures, and secure highly scalable, multi-country Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that will cement Malt's dominance in the German-speaking market and beyond.

    • Key Responsibilities ✨

    Pillar 1: Strategic Territory Architecture & Hunting

  • Action: Map out complex, global enterprise accounts within the DACH region, aggressively designing and executing surgical prospecting strategies to breach heavily fortified multi-stakeholder environments (Procurement, HR, and independent Business Units).
  • Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new DACH Enterprise logos and concrete, multi-threaded stakeholder maps.
  • Metrics of Performance: Enterprise GSV Pipeline Generated and CRM forecast integrity.

    • Pillar 2: Deal Orchestration & RFP Command

  • Action: Run rigorous, in-depth discovery utilizing the full MEDDIC framework to validate severe business pain, identify the true Economic Buyer, and aggressively lead end-to-end RFI/RFP processes alongside our Bid Management and technical teams.
  • Output: Compelling, ROI-driven business proposals and precisely engineered enterprise pilot programs designed to prove undeniable platform value.
  • Metrics of Performance: RFI/RFP Win Rate and Pilot-to-MSA Conversion Rate.

    • Pillar 3: Heavy-Weight Negotiation & Scalable Revenue Activation

  • Action: Command ruthless, complex negotiations for global Master Service Agreements involving tight friction with Legal, Finance, and Procurement across multiple countries. Upon signature, engineer the scalable handover strategy to the local Account Management teams.
  • Output: Executed, multi-country MSAs and comprehensive post-signature deployment kickoff plans.
  • Metrics of Performance: Total Contract Value (TCV) Signed and Deal Velocity (managing complex cycles efficiently without losing momentum).

    • Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍

    Proven Mastery (What you have already built):

  • A minimum of 8 years of quantifiable, proven track record hunting and closing complex, 7-figure B2B sales cycles within a SaaS/Tech environment.
  • Deep familiarity with the staffing, "future of work" industry, MSPs, or Tier 1 recruitment groups.
  • Demonstrated success navigating extremely long sales cycles and managing strategic concessions to close highly scalable deals.
  • Native-level fluency in German and full professional fluency in English.

    • Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

  • Advanced MEDDIC Mastery: You will deploy this framework with such rigor that you act as the internal benchmark and can actively coach others on its nuances.

title: Senior Electronic Warfare Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Hypersonica
description_html:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do 

  • Own the system architecture of Hypersonica's Electronic Warfare (EW) capability, ensuring electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), and electronic protection (EP) functions operate as a coherent and mission-effective system. 

  • Define, maintain, and manage EW system requirements, ensuring full traceability from operational needs through system architecture, subsystem allocation, verification, and validation. 

  • Lead the development of EW system architectures, performance budgets, interface definitions, and mission integrations across airborne platforms and payloads. 

  • Conduct threat, signal, and electromagnetic environment analyses to assess system effectiveness against representative adversary capabilities and operational conditions. 

  • Lead the integration of RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antenna systems, signal processing functions, mission computers, and platform interfaces into a coherent operational capability. 

  • Define and oversee system-level modelling, simulation, laboratory testing, ground trials, and flight trials, using evidence-based analysis to drive design improvements and risk reduction. 

  • Produce and maintain critical systems engineering artefacts including system specifications, interface control documents (ICDs), verification strategies, test plans, and design review materials. 

  • Apply model-based systems engineering (MBSE) principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and operational outcomes. 

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks, particularly around electromagnetic performance, interoperability, survivability, cybersecurity, verification, and platform integration. 

  • Act as the technical authority for EW system engineering, working across RF, software, hardware, mission systems, cybersecurity, safety, and platform engineering disciplines to deliver robust operational capability. 


Who you are 

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex Electronic Warfare, RF, mission systems, avionics, aerospace, defence, or other mission-critical systems. 

  • Strong background in systems architecture, requirements development, requirements decomposition, verification, and validation throughout the engineering lifecycle. 

  • Deep understanding of Electronic Warfare concepts, including electronic support (ES), electronic attack (EA), electronic protection (EP), threat systems, and electromagnetic spectrum operations. 

  • Experience integrating RF sensors, receivers, transmitters, antennas, signal processing systems, and mission computers into operational platforms. 

  • Strong knowledge of electromagnetic environments, system performance analysis, modelling, simulation, and test methodologies. 

  • Familiar with MBSE approaches and capable of applying systems engineering rigour to complex, multidisciplinary defence programmes. 

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, platform integration activities, flight trials, qualification programmes, and operational capability development. 

  • Technically credible across multiple disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction confidently. 

  • Comfortable operating within fast-moving, high-accountability environments where ambiguity is high and execution speed matters. 

  • Motivated by solving nationally significant defence challenges and building capabilities that directly contribute to European security and technological independence. 


Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work done at Hypersonica, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for Security Clearance. 


What we offer 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
 
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
 
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

description_html:
ABOUT US

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  

At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 750 experts from 70 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  

Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or a dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.    

 
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany, and Luxembourg, with our HQ in Berlin.  

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Payment Processing team owns the core of Unzer's platform — the systems that authorise, capture and settle every merchant transaction, at high volume and under strict reliability and compliance demands. We're also building AI into both our tooling and our payment flows. The team is cross-functional and owns its services end to end; as Engineering Manager, you'll lead experienced engineers and work closely with Product, Risk and Operations.

 

What your work will look like:

  • Leads, mentors, and grows a team of engineers, owning hiring, performance management, and career development. 

  • Remains hands-on when needed, contributing to the codebase, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting the team with your technical expertise. 

  • Takes accountability for the delivery, quality, and reliability of one or more product areas, balancing technical and business priorities. 

  • Partners with product and other stakeholders to shape roadmaps, plan capacity, and ensure predictable delivery. 

  • Drives continuous improvement of engineering practices, tooling, and processes, and removes blockers for the team. 

  • Contributes to technical and architectural direction, ensuring sound decisions while empowering engineers to own the details. 


What you need to be successful in this role:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or similar, with substantial software engineering experience and prior people-management or tech-lead experience. 

  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop engineers, and to build inclusive, motivated teams. 

  • Strong technical grounding (e.g., Java, Kotlin, and/or JavaScript, large-scale systems) sufficient to guide architecture and challenge decisions—without needing to be the hands-on expert. 

  • Familiarity with Agentic Software Engineering and AI-driven development lifecycles, and how to adopt them within a team. 

  • Deep understanding of Agile delivery, CI/CD, and quality practices, plus excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across teams and functions.

  • Experience with cloud-based, containerized environments (Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. 

  • Please note that we will not sponsor your visa or relocation, and you must have a valid work permit to be eligible for this position.

Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability.

description_html:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Welcome to ProcessOut

ProcessOut is a pioneer in the payment orchestration space. We are on a mission to help merchants build, scale and optimize their payment infrastructure. We work to bring simplicity, flexibility & performance to payments.

Millions of transactions are routed via ProcessOut everyday for merchants all over the world. We are proud to partner with amazing merchants like Glovo, Bolt, Sainsbury’s, Dott, Rakuten and many more!

We were acquired by Checkout.com in 2020 with the goal of growing our global reach.

If you are looking to join a very fast-moving company with passionate, hard-working & fun teams, ProcessOut is for you! At ProcessOut, we are looking for people who are convinced they can play a central part in the Company's success! We are looking for people who are passionate, who are looking to achieve their full potential & who will actively contribute to strengthen the links between our teams. We value people that fully own their work and are passionate about building the next generation of online payments with us.

The role

At ProcessOut, Implementation Engineers play a central role in the success of the Company. We are looking for a highly motivated person to join our Merchant Experience team and work alongside colleagues to help customers get world-class guidance and advice during the implementation of ProcessOut.

You will play a critical role in helping customers go-live, in maintaining their trust and ensuring a strong feedback loop within our teams to continuously improve our products suite.

The ideal candidate must be customer-driven and tech-savvy with eagerness to learn in a fast-growing environment facing complex challenges.

What we’re looking for

  • In-depth technical knowledge, particularly with a robust understanding of SaaS companies, web services, APIs, web applications, mobile apps, and IT infrastructure essential for effective

  • Native level French or English communication skills complemented by a strong business acumen.

  • Able to read and analyze server and application logs and debug errors.

  • Strong experience working with REST HTTP APIs.

  • Strong experience in project management, and ideally customer onboarding.

  • Ability to investigate and solve complex technical problems to offer the best solutions to our customers.

Bonus points for

  • Experience in a similar role in a tech company.

  • Experience and knowledge working in the online payments industry.

  • Prior customer service experience working in a merchant-facing role.

Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Join Back Market's dynamic Seller Success team as the driving force behind our seller ecosystem! As Europe's leading refurbished electronics marketplace, we're revolutionizing how businesses connect with millions of customers across the EU, the UK and the US.

As a Seller Activation Intern (Onboarding & Seller Support), you'll be at the heart of our growth strategy, transforming thousands of potential sellers into thriving Back Market partners. You'll master the art of business prioritization, relationship building, and data-driven decision making while gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe's fastest-growing tech companies.

This isn't just about processing applications – you'll be identifying high-potential business opportunities, strategically prioritizing sellers based on market potential, and directly impacting our marketplace expansion across Europe and the United States. At the same time, you'll play a hands-on role in improving how we work — collaborating with cross-functional teams to spot inefficiencies in our seller activation processes and helping design better, more scalable solutions.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Strategic Seller Management: Navigate through our extensive database of thousands of potential sellers, qualifying and prioritizing them based on business potential and strategic fit

  • Business Development: Provide professional consultation and support via Salesforce, guiding sellers through our comprehensive onboarding journey from initial sign-up to successful activation

  • Data-Driven Prioritization: Leverage Excel and Salesforce to analyze seller profiles, create strategic reports, and identify the most promising business opportunities

  • Projects : Take ownership of improvement projects end to end. You'll get your hands dirty identifying pain points, spotting repetitive tasks ripe for automation, and driving solutions from idea to implementation with the help of your manager — not just flagging issues, but fixing them.

  • International Impact: Communicate directly with sellers across Europe and the US, building strong professional relationships that drive business growth

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Seeking a 6-month full-time internship (Gap Year or End of Studies welcome)

  • Fluent English - you'll be the voice of Back Market to international sellers

  • Excel proficiency including pivot tables and data analysis capabilities

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail - you'll manage high-volume, process-intensive workflows

  • Passionate about business development/sales with a keen eye for identifying opportunities

  • Structured approach to work with ability to prioritize effectively in fast-paced environments

Bonus Points:

  • French language skills

  • Salesforce experience or CRM familiarity

  • Previous commercial or e-commerce experience

  • Proactive mindset with initiative for process improvements

  • Additional European languages

Ideal Profile: We're looking for ambitious, friendly yet professional students who are genuinely excited about sales, business development, and e-commerce — and who don't just want to observe, but to build. The ideal candidate is curious about how processes work, quick to spot inefficiencies, and motivated to own solutions from start to finish. Whether you're taking a gap year or completing your studies, what matters most is your motivation, business acumen, and eagerness to make a real impact.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months (until June 2027)

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager (Reviewing the job description and missions, your CV and past experiences/projects)

  • Video-call HR Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

description_html:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

Our team is growing and we are looking for an Implementation Consultant (Forward Deployed Consultant) to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will train, advise and consult, and build with customers to optimise their use of the monday.com AI work platform during the course of an AI transformation, implementation, or ongoing managed services engagement. You will design and build the AI-native solutions that get them there, from intelligent workflows and agents to the automations and reporting their business relies on. You will run engagements both independently and as a part of a delivery team collaborating with deployment strategists and engineers.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

  • Lead AI transformation and implementation engagements for monday.com customers, designing and building tailored solutions using agents, vibe-coded applications, and other advanced capabilities of the monday AI work platform.

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, running the discovery that uncovers their desired business outcomes, and ensure successful adoption of the solutions you deliver across their organization.

  • Consult on business process design, mapping how work moves through a customer's organization and recommending the process changes that should be made before the solution is built.

  • Design sophisticated workflows and relational data structures within the monday.com platform to solve complex business cases, partnering with technical resources for data conversions, integrations, and agentic engineering.

  • Actively leverage monday AI and external Generative/Agentic AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate complex business logic, and deliver intelligent workflows for our customers.

  • Act as the project manager on standalone engagements, building and executing on project plans that ensure deliverables stay on-time and on-budget, and delivering defined scope alongside a deployment strategist on larger ones.

  • Run online webinars, training sessions, consultations, and one-on-one demos that show customers how our product capabilities translate into business value.

  • Produce the documentation, walkthroughs, and exit artifacts for your engagements that allow customers to operate, maintain, and extend what you built independently.

  • Represent the voice of the customer by advocating for their needs and influencing the product development roadmap.

  • Contribute the patterns and reusable assets you develop in the field back to our shared asset library.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a forward deployed consultant, implementation consultant, solutions consultant, or technical project manager in enterprise software.

  • Experience leading software implementation or managed services projects that required hands-on build and system configuration in project management, CRM, service desk, or collaborative work management software.

  • Fluency in Generative and Agentic AI tools, with a strong understanding of how to leverage AI in streamlining work productivity and building intelligent workflows and agents.

  • Familiarity with what keeps AI reliable in production, including human review, checking outputs, and knowing when a deterministic automation is the better answer.

  • Strong problem solving skills, rooted in computational thinking, systems design, and an understanding of relational data structures.

  • Business process design and consulting experience, with the business acumen to frame an engagement around customer outcomes, and the judgment to read the implicit problem behind an explicit request.

  • Working knowledge of integration platforms (make.com, Zapier) sufficient to configure lightweight integrations yourself, with foundational knowledge of APIs (GraphQL) and MCP a plus.

  • Strong customer-facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with client stakeholders and executives, and to clearly articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience.

  • Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies across a changing set of customers and industries.

  • Detail-oriented with strong project management skills, comfortable running engagements independently and working across several at once.

  • Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, high energy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt.

  • BA or BS degree preferred.


Please note that this role is hybrid.

The remote, work from home part-time staff pharmacist provides telepharmacy services to multiple hospital clients across various states. This role enhances clinical team performance, supports quality patient care, and ensures safe and compliant medication practices. This part-time position includes evenings, overnight and on-call shifts. You are expected to work at least 1-2 shifts every 2 weeks. Multiple shifts available and will be discussed in interview, but consist of evenings, overnight, and weekends.

Responsibilities:

Telepharmacy

  • Perform remote order entry, order verification, drug verification, and patient/staff counseling.
  • Support multiple clients and operate within various pharmacy information systems (PIS).

Clinical Excellence

  • Provide proactive clinical pharmacy services and adhere to all client -specific and Cigna policies.
  • Deliver drug information and therapeutic recommendations, including dosing adjustments, interactions, compatibilities, and infusion guidance.
  • Maintain working knowledge of IV fluids, TPN, narcotic/cardiac drips, IV antibiotics, chemotherapy, and more.
  • Understand considerations for special populations (pediatric, geriatric, pregnant/nursing, renal/hepatic impairment, HIV).
  • Counsel patients, nurses, and medical staff on safe medication use.
  • Investigate and resolve medication variances within 48 hours.

Operational Excellence

  • Learn and work in multiple hospital pharmacy systems.
  • Obtain and maintain multiple state pharmacist licenses.
  • Document orders, interventions, and recommendations in system by end of shift.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable pharmacy laws, regulations, and Internal policies.

Technical Excellence

  • Perform basic troubleshooting during system or connectivity issues.
  • Work effectively with VPNs, PIS platforms, automation systems, and common software (Microsoft Office, Snagit, etc.).

Training & Development

  • Participate in ongoing training, including clinical updates, PIS enhancements, and policy changes.
  • Maintain all required access credentials, licenses, and reciprocity.

Productivity

  • Achieve and maintain company productivity metrics.

Qualifications

  • B.S. in Pharmacy required, PharmD preferred.
  • Active and in good standing pharmacist license (PA and/or OH)
  • Additional state licenses preferred (MA, RI, DE, ME, NH, CT)
  • At least 2+ years of inpatient hospital experience preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrated customer service skills
  • Knowledge of formulary management and P&T procedures
  • Familiarity with client/server applications
  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Drive, internet, and email
  • Overnight inpatient hospital experience is strongly preferred
  • Hospital residency is preferred but not required
  • Board certification is preferred but not required


If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

title: Account Executive, Commercial - Mexico
description_html:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. You will be selling over zoom and not in person.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Zvoove
description_html:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.
