title: Senior Process Engieer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Tozero
description_html:
ABOUT US

tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of
lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming
the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a
cleaner and more innovative future.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the
design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes.
This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering,
and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into
robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our
future plants are built on solid fundamentals.
Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite
and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external
engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with:
a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production
environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is
telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

Must Have's:
1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up
● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants.
● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process
descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions.

● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design
criteria and scale-up assumptions.
● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future
plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than
theoretical assumptions alone.
2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization
● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps.
● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of
graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing.
● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and
translate these insights into concrete process improvements.
● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on
process performance and technology development rather than daily
troubleshooting.
3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling
● Turn plant data into engineering decisions.
● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances
and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process
performance.
● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions.
● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure
that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality.
● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and
future plant designs.
4. Commissioning & Process Validation
● Make sure what we designed actually works.
● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance
validation for new equipment and plant expansions.
● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original
design intent.
● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed
systems achieve their calculated performance targets.
● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership
transfers once the process meets its design criteria.
5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs
● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently.
● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation.
● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews,
ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather
than after installation.
● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process
parameters of newly commissioned systems.

Nice-to-have's:
Vendor & EPC Coordination
● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners
and equipment suppliers.
● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering
documentation.
● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and
ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process.
● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process
performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability.
● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and
equipment vendors throughout project execution.


Your profile

You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving
technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and
real plant data.
● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical
Engineering or a related technical field.
● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical,
hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process
industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and
post-processing is highly preferred.
● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs,
mass/energy balances and equipment sizing.
● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data
into engineering models and decisions.
● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation,
hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable.
● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical
assumptions.
● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of
industrial equipment or plants.
● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA.
● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering
documentation and the actual plant.
● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering,
Operations, suppliers and EPC partners.
● Fluent English; German is a plus.


Why us?

Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward
increasingly larger and more standardized plants.
The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning
what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants
while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts.
You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the
technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is
safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it.

description_html:
About us

Since 2000, ITA Logistics Group has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel/ LMS Next, companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.


Your mission

As a Working Student (d/f/m) in our Invoicing Team, you will join us at the earliest possible date and support us with reviewing carrier invoices, contributing to efficient and reliable billing processes. You will be part of an international team of seven colleagues, based across Hamburg, Naarden, Nantes, and Madrid.

You can look forward to a working environment where mutual support, team spirit, and positive collaboration are at the heart of how we work.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for reviewing and checking carrier invoices across different brands and countries.

  • You handle related invoice claims and clarify any discrepancies.

  • You review carrier rates and ensure they are correctly reflected in the invoice checks.

  • You gather the information required for invoice checks from relevant stakeholders and coordinate with them.

  • As part of the invoice checking process for LMS Next, you also support the posting of carrier invoices.

  • You support the testing of improvements to the invoice checking process before they are implemented.

  • You support the implementation of our new accounting system, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.


What you need to succeed

  • You are currently enrolled at a university and would like to gain practical experience in invoice checking, accounts payable/receivable, and an international working environment.

  • You enjoy working with numbers and have a careful and accurate approach to your work.

  • You approach your tasks in a structured, efficient, and independent manner.

  • You are open-minded, curious, and enjoy working as part of a team.

  • You have good to very good proficiency in German and English, enabling you to communicate confidently within our international team.

  • Initial knowledge or experience in the transport and logistics sector is an advantage, but not a requirement.


Why ITA Logistics Group?

You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

  • 30 days of vacation

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work 

  • Time tracking and overtime compensation 

  • Subsidized HVV/Deutschlandticket or parking 

  • SpenditCard with a monthly credit of €50

  • Corporate Benefits Program

  • Counseling and support services through the Fürstenberg Institute


Join the ITA Crew

You feel addressed and are interested in joining our team as a Working Student – Invoice Checking (d/f/m) in beautiful Hamburg?
Please apply stating your earliest possible starting date! Ulrike Le Quéré is looking forward to your application. 

We welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, disabilities, sexual orientations, and religions.

Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if equally qualified.

You can find more information at www.letmeship.com.

title: Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR DACH)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Vivid
description_html:
About The Role

Vivid Money is redefining how modern businesses, growing SMEs, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From high-yield Interest Accounts and multi-currency infrastructure to treasury tools and team cards, we provide the modern financial platform that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.

We are expanding our business presence across Germany.

We aren’t looking for an SDR to just follow a pre-written playbook; we are looking for our Founding SDR for the DACH market. Working directly alongside our Founding Account Executive, you will be employee number one on the SDR side, responsible for building the outbound engine from scratch. Your core focus will be opening doors with SMB decision-makers (CEOs, CFOs, Finance Directors), while strategically mapping and testing outreach to adjacent personas like holding structures, PE/VC portfolio leads, and family offices.

If you want the autonomy of a founding team member, want to write the prospecting playbook, and want to establish the top-of-funnel blueprint for Vivid in Germany, this role is for you.


Your Mission

  • Build the Outbound Engine: Architect, build, and test our cold outreach sequences across phone, email, and LinkedIn targeting SMB decision-makers across Germany.
  • Map & Test New Personas: Experiment with outreach strategies for secondary personas, including holding companies, VC/PE portfolio managers, and corporate service providers, to help define our expanded ICP.
  • Generate High-Volume Pipeline: Own top-of-funnel growth by sourcing, qualifying, and booking high-intent discovery meetings for the Founding Account Executive.
  • Design the Playbook: Partner directly with Sales Leadership to document what works, establishing the framework, templates, and best practices for future SDR hires.
  • Leverage AI & Sales Infrastructure: Help select, implement, and optimize our AI-native prospecting stack, utilizing AI tools to automate research, trigger tracking, and hyper-personalized messaging.
  • Continuous Feedback Loop: Gather market feedback from prospect interactions to help refine product positioning, objections handling, and GTM messaging.


Your Profile

  • 1–3 years of outbound prospecting experience (SDR/BDR) in B2B FinTech, SaaS, or financial services, preferably within the DACH market.
  • Founding/Builder mindset: High agency, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating processes from scratch rather than just executing existing ones.
  • Persona curiosity: Ability to speak the language of SMB founders and CFOs, with a strong interest in learning how different corporate entities and treasury setups operate.
  • Tech-savvy & AI-native: Active user of modern sales stacks and AI prospecting tools to maximize outreach efficiency.
  • Tenacious & resilient: Motivated by raw pipeline creation, testing new angles, and iterating quickly based on response data.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in German and English is required.


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. 
  • Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. 
  • Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities. 
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

title: Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) – HGB & IFRS

description_html:
Gestalte den Versorgungsmarkt der Zukunft mit uns!

Festanstellung / Vollzeit / Erfurt oder Leipzig, Hybrid / Start: ASAP

Du möchtest Abschlüsse nicht nur erstellen, sondern Accounting-Prozesse in einem internationalen Softwareunternehmen aktiv mitgestalten?

Als Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) übernimmst du Verantwortung für unsere Finanzprozesse und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Abschlüsse zuverlässig, transparent und aussagekräftig sind. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Director Finance & Legal zusammen und entwickelst unsere Prozesse Schritt für Schritt weiter.

Cuculus entwickelt Softwarelösungen für Energieversorger weltweit. Dich erwartet ein internationales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung – und der Möglichkeit, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Abschlüsse: Du erstellst eigenständig Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB und IFRS – dabei stellst du die Qualität und Vollständigkeit unserer Finanzdaten sicher.
  • Bewertungen & Abgrenzungen: Du bewertest Rückstellungen und Vorräte und stellst periodengerechte Abgrenzungen sicher.
  • Steuern: Du bereitest Steuererklärungen vor, betreust Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und begleitest Betriebsprüfungen.
  • Kontenabstimmung & Audits: Du stimmst Haupt- und Nebenbücher ab und arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Auditor:innen zusammen.
  • Laufende Buchhaltung: Du verantwortest die laufende Buchhaltung mit und sorgst für die korrekte Erfassung, Prüfung und Abstimmung der Geschäftsvorfälle – von Debitoren und Kreditoren bis zum Hauptbuch.
  • KI & Automatisierung: Du bringst Ideen ein, wie wir Routinearbeit reduzieren und Finance-Prozesse optimieren können – und setzt dies gemeinsam mit dem Director Finance & Legal um.


Dein Profil

  • Accounting-Erfahrung: Mindestens fünf Jahre im Accounting mit Abschlussverantwortung. 
  • Qualifikation: Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK), kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder vergleichbar. Erfahrung aus einer Steuerberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • HGB & IFRS: Fundierte Kenntnisse, die du in der Praxis sicher anwendest.
  • Systeme: Excel gehört für dich zum Arbeitsalltag. Sage 100 und Candis sind ein Plus.
  • KI-Affinität: Du nutzt KI-Tools bereits im Arbeitsalltag - oder hast Lust, damit anzufangen.
  • Englisch & Deutsch: Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch - gute Englischkenntnisse sind also ein Muss. Außerdem kommunizierst du verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch mit Steuerberatung, Behörden und Auditor:innen. 
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, setzt selbstständig Prioritäten und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Du möchtest nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern deinen Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitgestalten.

description_html:
What you can expect from us

We are a technical, implementation-oriented spin-off of a global management consultancy. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies, which we advise on issues in the areas of analytics, big data and machine learning. Within the group, we take on the development of individual and data-driven solutions in order to transform our clients into AI-powered companies. We offer an international working environment with agile teams and creative startup methods as well as above-average remuneration and numerous additional benefits. With our offices in Hamburg, Munich and Düsseldorf and our hub locations in all other major German cities (Berlin, Frankfurt and Stuttgart), we ensure that all colleagues are integrated into our team of experts across Germany.

Your role as a Senior GenAI Solution Engineer:

  • End-to-End Development: You drive AI solutions across the full lifecycle - from rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept to deployment in scalable, highly available production environments.
  • AI Services Engineering: You build robust backend services in Python that seamlessly integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and perform reliably under production load.
  • Autonomous Agent Architecture: You design and implement intelligent agent systems that automate real-world workflows through tool calling and memory management, operating safely within defined guardrails.
  • Agentic SDLC: You integrate AI agents into the development lifecycle - from AI-assisted coding and code reviews to automated testing and intelligent documentation - enhancing efficiency across the entire software development process through agentic tools.
  • Ensuring Software Excellence: You take ownership of code quality by applying clean architecture principles, implementing automated testing, and establishing efficient CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth and reliable deployments.
  • Evaluation & Monitoring: You implement frameworks to measure the performance of GenAI solutions (e.g., accuracy, latency, cost) and ensure continuous optimization.
  • Consulting: You work directly with clients - facilitating workshops and acting as a sparring partner for business and management stakeholders. You translate complex AI concepts into tangible business impact and co-create the right solutions.
  • Technology Sparring: You assess technical feasibility and advise stakeholders on how to turn innovative ideas into sustainable, production-ready products.


Who you are

  • Excellent Python Skills (Production-Ready): You have strong expertise in API development (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic), containerization (Docker), testing (unit and integration), as well as Git and CI/CD - well beyond notebook-based scripting.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Ability to quickly build and visualize demos and proof-of-concepts.
  • Strong Architectural Understanding: You apply SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and async/concurrency patterns in a structured way, and leverage ORMs (e.g., SQLAlchemy) for clean and efficient database interactions.
  • Hands-on Experience with Multimodal LLM APIs: Proficient in working with leading models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
  • Advanced GenAI Engineering: Strong command of prompt engineering, structured outputs (JSON), and tool/function calling.
  • RAG Expertise (End-to-End): Experience in building full pipelines - from embeddings and vector databases (e.g., pgvector) to advanced retrieval, re-ranking, and evaluation.
  • Agent Development: Experience in designing and orchestrating autonomous systems (e.g., with Pydantic AI), including memory management and guardrails.
  • Consulting Skills: Experience working directly with clients. You are able to facilitate workshops, present results, and confidently navigate complex stakeholder environments.
  • Languages: Fluent in German (C1), with professional proficiency in English.
  • Education: Completed degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a comparable field (Bachelor’s degree or higher).
  • Willingness to travel: You are willing to work on-site at the client’s premises on a regular basis


Who we are

  • Shape the future with (Gen)AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
  • Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
  • Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
  • A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
  • Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.
  • Maintain a healthy work-life balance with flexible working models and, where appropriate, the opportunity to take a sabbatical.

  • Work from modern, centrally located offices in Hamburg, Munich, and Düsseldorf, as well as flexible hub locations across Germany's major cities.
  • Enjoy complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, snacks, premium coffee – and, if you like, an after-work beer with your colleagues.

As part of our Sourcing & IT Advisory team, you will help clients shape and deliver complex business and IT transformations across industries.

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close.

We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect:

  • You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production
  • You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments
  • Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines
  • You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way
  • You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact

  • You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture
  • You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it
  • Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer
  • Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI, containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling
  • You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines
  • An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side
  • Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence. More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment

description_html:
What you can expect from us

At Eraneos Germany, we partner with organizations to master complex challenges and shape a sustainable, digital future. As a (Senior) Consultant in our Production & Operations team, you will support leading organizations in navigating change and unlocking performance improvements. Working in multidisciplinary project teams, you will contribute to strategic and operational transformation initiatives, develop valuable industry expertise, and help clients translate ambitious goals into tangible business results.

Your Responsibilities

  • Support transformation and operational improvement projects across manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering environments
  • Analyze business processes and operational performance to identify improvement opportunities and support decision-making
  • Contribute to the design of target operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
  • Support operational strategy and optimization initiatives across manufacturing, supply chain, and operations
  • Apply lean and continuous improvement methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and business outcomes
  • Develop client deliverables and support workshops, stakeholder engagement, and project execution activities


Who you are

Are you an analytical thinker with strong social skills, are curious and enjoy working as a team player? In addition to a high degree of personal initiative and an entrepreneurial can-do mentality, you possess the following distinguishing qualities:

  • 2+ years of experience in management consulting, delivering transformation and operational improvement projects across manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering environments
  • University degree in engineering, business administration, economics, or a comparable field
  • Understanding of operational processes,continuous improvement methodologies and transformation initiatives in industrial environments
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage effectively with different stakeholders
  • Fluent German and English language skills
  • Flexibility and willingness to travel based on client and project needs


Who we are

Eraneos is an international consulting group specializing in strategy, transformation, and technology that helps companies succeed in a dynamic digital world. With world-class experts in business and technology, we empower our clients to set new standards for sustainable transformation – from strategy to implementation. Whether designing future-proof organizations, unlocking new potential through data and AI, or safeguarding companies with comprehensive cybersecurity, we deliver results in a pragmatic and goal-oriented manner.

Our team of approximately 1,300 dedicated employees is based in offices across Germany, Switzerland, The Netherlands, Spain, Denmark, Sweden, Austria, The United Kingdom, Singapore, Japan and The United States and combines global perspectives with strong local roots.

In addition to challenging projects in a multinational environment, we are characterized by a high degree of entrepreneurial freedom and continuous growth. At our company, we take pride in our strong sense of community, based on mutual appreciation and support. We offer excellent promotion opportunities as well as individual career development mentoring. Our employees are seen as the heart of the company, which is why we provide above-average compensation as well as numerous additional benefits.


Contact

Patricia Herbst - 
Our top priority is that you fit us and we fit you, regardless of origin, nationality, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity, age, handicap or other aspects of diversity.

Our dedicated HR Team will be happy to provide you with further information and is looking forward to receiving your CV and / or your complete and expressive Linked in / Xing profile.

Are you interested in what our employees and other applicants say about us? Visit us on Kununu and follow us on social media to not miss the latest news about us.

description_html:
It’s time to change. We change!

Über uns
It’s time to change. We change! Willkommen bei Auvaria, wo Leidenschaft, Teamgeist und Verantwortung unsere Kultur prägen. Wir sind ein mehrfach ausgezeichneter AWS Consulting & Engineering Partner mit Büros in Wien, Hamburg und Belgrad und begleiten unsere Kunden als Trusted Advisor auf der gesamten Cloud Journey.

Über die Rolle
Was auch immer unsere Kunden im Bereich Data & AI auf AWS vorhaben, wir entwerfen und entwickeln es gemeinsam vom ersten Architecture Workshop bis in Production mit ihnen. Dafür suchen wir dich: als Senior Solutions Architect für Data & AI verantwortest du End-to-End Projekte in deinem Bereich und gestaltest unsere wachsende Data & AI Business Unit aktiv mit.

Architektur & Delivery 

  • Du führst die Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbare AWS-Architekturen für Data Platforms und Gen AI- / Agentic AI-Lösungen
  • Du sorgst für Security, Performance, Reliability und Kosteneffizienz bei unseren Kunden (AWS Well-Architected)
  • Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen samt Trade-offs – und dokumentierst sie so, dass Teams darauf aufbauen können
  • Du übersetzt vage Business-Pain-Points in messbare technische Anforderungen und klare Ziele
  • Du bringst Außenperspektive ein und hebst unsere bestehenden Standards auf das nächste Level.
  • Du beteiligst dich bei technical Pre-Sales, Scoping von Projekten und arbeitest an der Erstellung der Statements of Work
Data & AI 
  • Du entwickelst Generative AI und Agentic AI Solutions auf AWS Bedrock, mit Frameworks wie Strands Agents und Runtime- / Governance-Bausteinen wie Bedrock AgentCore
  • Du entwickelst Agenten-Architekturen mit Tool Use und MCP-basierten Integrationen, Multi-Step-Orchestrierung und klar definierten Grenzen des Agent-Scopes
  • Du baust Human-in-the-Loop-Patterns ein, von Approval-Steps und Eskalationslogik bis zu (teil-)automatisierten Review-Schleifen
  • Du etablierst Evaluation und Qualitätssicherung für LLM- und Agent-Systeme
  • Du zeigst Kunden, wie sie GenAI und Agentic AI pragmatisch und verantwortungsvoll einsetzen
Consulting & Pre-Sales 
  • Du bist Trusted Technical Advisor für unsere Kunden
  • Du unterstützt Pre-Sales und technische Workshops
  • Du übersetzt komplexe Technik in klaren Business Value
  • Knowledge Sharing
  • Du bist Mentor:in für unsere Junior-Kolleg:innen
  • Du bringst dich in interne Standards, Best Practices und Trainings ein und entwickelst diese mit uns weiter


Dein Profil:

Must-haves 

  • 5+ Jahre in Cloud, Data, Software oder ML Engineering – davon 2+ Jahre mit Ownership für End-to-End-Architekturen
  • Starke Hands-on-Expertise mit AWS
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Data Engineering und ETL-Architekturen
  • Erfahrung mit Generative / Agentic AI Projekten
  • Sehr gute Python-Skills
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch; Deutsch auf professionellem Niveau

Nice-to-haves 
  • AWS-Zertifizierungen
  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales oder technischer Führung
  • Erfahrung im Consulting oder in kundennahen Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit AWS Connect
  • Solide Erfahrung mit IaC (Terraform oder vergleichbar)
  • Erfahrung mit LLM Customization / Fine-Tuning und Distillation
  • Praktische MLOps-Erfahrung (Model Deployment, Monitoring, Lifecycle)
  • Erfahrung mit Kafka/Streaming


Erstklassige Benefits für deine Karriere!

Vergütung und Vergütungspaket
Bei Auvaria bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass Performance nur unter den richtigen Bedingungen gelingen kann:

  • 4-Tage-Woche (bei 36h reduzierter Wochenarbeitszeit) mit vollem Fokus auf Impact.
  • Attraktives Package mit teilweise variablem Gehaltsbestandteil, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung.
  • Schneller, transparenter Hiring-Prozess (in der Regel max. 3 Gespräche, Angebot typischerweise innerhalb von 4 Wochen).
  • Persönliches Mentoring und strukturiertes Onboarding ab Tag 1. AWS-Zertifizierungen komplett von uns bezahlt.
  • Remote-freundliches Setup mit wenig Reisetätigkeit (max. 20 % im Jahresschnitt). Regelmäßige Team- und Afterwork-Events an unseren Standorten plus gemeinsame Offsites.
Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance Process Automatisation bis zu 20 Stunden/Woche
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Ecotel
description_html:
MIT DIR GEMEINSAM: DIE ZUKUNFT BEWEGEN!

Sammle Praxiserfahrung in Finance & Digitalisierung – mitten in der Prozessautomatisierung
 
Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Data Science, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen endlich in der Praxis anwenden? Du interessierst dich für Daten, digitale Prozesse und Automatisierung, arbeitest strukturiert und möchtest Teil eines motivierten Teams werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 
Bei ecotel arbeitest du nicht nur mit – du gestaltest mit. Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team im Bereich Commissions im operativen Tagesgeschäft und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Automatisierung von Finanzprozessen. Dabei arbeitest du mit Daten, unterstützt bei bestehenden Prozessen und lernst moderne Technologien und Schnittstellen kennen.
 
Das erwartet dich
 
Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team bei der Durchführung, Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Prozesse im Finanzbereich. Dabei übernimmst du klar definierte Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitest an kleineren Daten- und Automatisierungsthemen mit.
 
Unter anderem unterstützt du bei:
 

  • Pflege und Überwachung bestehender ETL-Prozesse sowie automatisierter Abläufe
  • Durchführung von Datenvalidierungen, Tests und Qualitätsprüfungen
  • Unterstützung bei Monatsabschlussprozessen und Ad-hoc-Anfragen
  • Mitarbeit an Automatisierungen mit Python, SQL und REST-APIs
  • Aufbereitung von Reports und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen
 
Das bringst du mit
 
  • Laufendes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Data Science, BWL oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs
  • Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie Interesse an Python und Prozessautomatisierung
  • Verständnis für Datenstrukturen und Schnittstellen zwischen Systemen
  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Teamgeist und Freude daran, Neues zu lernen
 
Berufserfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – wichtiger sind deine Motivation und dein Interesse an Daten und digitalen Prozessen.
 
Darauf kannst du dich freuen
 
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche, passend zu deinem Studium
  • Freie Verteilung deiner Arbeitszeit – zum Beispiel zwei volle Tage und ein halber Tag oder ganz nach Absprache
  • Praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, SQL und modernen Datenprozessen
  • Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und Mitarbeit an spannenden Projekten
  • Eine intensive Einarbeitung sowie persönliche Betreuung
 
 Deine Entwicklung
 
  • Praxisnahe Einblicke in die Digitalisierung von Finanzprozessen
  • Aufbau von Kenntnissen in SQL, Python und ETL-Prozessen
  • Mitarbeit an Daten- und Automatisierungsprojekten
  • Persönliche Betreuung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen
  • Wertvolle Berufserfahrung für deinen Karriereweg
 
Arbeiten bei ecotel
 
  • Duz-Kultur auf allen Ebenen
  • Offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier und Karneval
  • Modern ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze
  • Firmenlaptop und moderne IT-Ausstattung
  • Fitnessraum am Standort Düsseldorf
  • Kostenlose Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst
  • Kostenfreie Parkplätze in unserer Tiefgarage
  • Sehr gute Verkehrsanbindung
  • 30 Urlaubstage sowie bezahlter Sonderurlaub bei besonderen persönlichen Ereignissen
  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
 
Attraktive Vergütung

 
  • 1.350 € brutto pro Monat bei einer 20-Stunden-Woche 
 
Klingt nach deinem nächsten Schritt?
 
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
 
Bitte sende uns folgende Unterlagen:
 
  • deinen Lebenslauf
  • deine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung
  • optional ein kurzes Anschreiben, in dem wir erfahren, warum du unser Team unterstützen möchtest
 
Vielfalt ist für uns selbstverständlich. Alter, Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Religion oder eine Behinderung spielen für uns keine Rolle – wir freuen uns auf Menschen mit Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Begeisterung für Digitalisierung.
 
Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – #readyfordigitalbusiness.
 
Dein Ansprechpartner: Dominic Schillers

title: (SENIOR) Relationship & Recruiting Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Synsero
description_html:
Kurzbeschreibung

Du liebst es, Menschen und Unternehmen erfolgreich zusammenzubringen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Als (Senior) Relationship & Recruiting Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Besetzung anspruchsvoller Fach- und Projektpositionen im Industrie- und Energiesektor. Dabei begleitest Du Freelancer von der ersten Ansprache bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung und arbeitest eng mit unserem Account Management zusammen.
Mit Deinem Gespür für Menschen, Deinem Blick auf den Markt und Deiner Leidenschaft für Recruiting identifizierst Du die besten Experten, führst Interviews, entwickelst nachhaltige Talentpools und berätst Kunden sowie Kandidaten als vertrauensvoller Ansprechpartner. Gleichzeitig bringst Du eigene Ideen ein, optimierst Prozesse und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum unseres Geschäfts bei.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess zur Besetzung spannender, nationaler und internationaler Positionen in Unternehmensübergreifenden Bereichen – von Projektmanagern, über SAP und PLM Spezialisten, bis hin zu Engineering Rollen – und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Account Management im 180°- Modell zusammen.
  • Du beobachtest den aktuellen Kandidatenmarkt und trittst bei unseren Kunden und Beratern als Experte rund um das Thema Recruiting auf.
  • Du gehst auf unterschiedlichen Businessportalen aktiv auf die Suche nach Experten, pitchst die zu besetzende Position und begeisterst potenzielle Kandidaten für uns und unsere Kunden.
  • Du analysierst CV´s und führst Interviews, um einen optimalen Fit sicherzustellen und die beste Vorauswahl für Deine Projekte zu treffen.
  • Du begleitest deine Experten entlang des gesamten Besetzungsprozesses vom Erstkontakt bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung, verhandelst Konditionen und stehst beratend zur Seite.
  • Du sorgst für eine nachvollziehbare und gute Struktur in unserem CRM und baust den Kandidatenpool weiter aus
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen und betreust mehrere Großkunden


Dein Profil

  • Du hast idealerweise erste Berufserfahrungen im Recruiting von bereichsübergreifenden Positionen im Industrie und Energiesektor oder verwandten Berufsfeldern und kennst die Personaldienstleistungsbranche.
  • Du kannst erste Erfolge in der Entwicklung effektiver Recruitingstrategien nachweisen und verstehst es, eine Kandidatenpipeline aufzubauen.
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen Tools und bist bereit, neue Wege zu gehen, um die besten Experten zu finden.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Datenmanagement von CRM Daten.
  • Du hast eine Leidenschaft für das Peoplebusiness, gehst proaktiv auf Menschen zu und hast Spaß an der Kommunikation mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
  • Du hast Spaß daran Prozesse zu verbessern und aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Du lebst eine ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative und Durchhaltevermögen.
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über einen Hochschulabschluss aus dem Bereich Wirtschaft
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1 Niveau) und sprichst fließend Englisch (mind. B2-C1 Niveau).


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket mit zusätzlichen Benefits
  • Individuelle Entwicklung: Mentor ab Tag 1, interne & externe Trainings
  • Modernste Technik und Ausstattung um sich auf die wesentlichen Dinge zu konzentrieren
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage zzgl. 24.12. und 31.12., Homeoffice & flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Teamtag: Mittwochs treffen wir uns alle im Büro um die Gemeinschaft zu stärken und werden auch mit einem Team-Lunch gestärkt
  • Mobilität & Familie: MVV-Zuschuss (bis 100 €/Monat), Kinderbetreuungszuschuss
  • Extras: Spendit-Karte (47 €/Monat), Zugang zu Wellhub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, kostenlose Getränke & frisches Obst
  • Modernes Büro im Herzen Münchens mit Dachterrasse, welche zum verweilen einlädt
  • Teamspirit: Regelmäßige Events & ein motiviertes Umfeld sowie ein modernes Büro mit bester technischer Ausstattung

title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mute Labs Gmbh
description_html:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

title: Senior Backend Engineer | Cybersecurity AI AppSec

description_html:
Location: Paris (75002) | Hybrid (2 days remote/week)

About Escape
Join Escape, a fast-growing leader in AI-powered cybersecurity. Our mission-driven engineering team (18 engineers, 4 technical leads, 3 product owners) is dedicated to redefining application security with cutting-edge detection and automation.

We operate at the forefront of technology and research from our Paris office.

About the Role
As a Senior Backend Engineer you will work in a team with talented security researchers. You’ll champion innovation, and ensure research translates into impactful production solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Agentic scanning systems: Build systems that autonomously explore applications, maintain context, and execute complex testing strategies.

  • Security detection engine: Design and implement reliable, production-grade vulnerability detection logic (injection, auth issues, business logic flaws, etc.).

  • AI-driven testing: Integrate LLMs and structured reasoning into scanning workflows to improve coverage and reduce false positives.

  • Distributed infrastructure: Work on systems that orchestrate thousands of concurrent scans (Kubernetes, queues, resource management).

  • Performance & reliability: Ensure scans are fast, deterministic, and cost-efficient despite high complexity and concurrency.

  • Core platform design: Contribute to architecture decisions around memory systems, execution environments, and data models.

Our Tech Stack & Focus

  • Languages: Python (primary), Go (performance/network components)

  • Runtime: Containerized workloads on Kubernetes (EKS), supporting long and resource-intensive scans

  • Scaling: Kubernetes Jobs & queue-driven autoscaling

  • Web Automation: Playwright + headless Chromium

  • Data: PostgreSQL, S3-compatible object storage, Redis (limited use)

  • Messaging: Kafka

  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Grafana Cloud

  • CI/CD & Infra: GitLab CI, Terraform

Perks & Benefits

  • 💸 Significant equity (Stock Options/BSPCE) – become a core stakeholder in Escape’s journey

  • ❤️‍🩹 Top-tier health insurance with Alan

  • 🍕 Meal vouchers with Swile

  • 💪 EGYM Wellpass sport subscription

  • 📚 Continuous learning: budgets for books and online courses

  • 💻 Premium equipment to support your work

  • 🎁 Dedicated time for open-source projects

  • 🌍 Present research at top international conferences (RSAC, BlackHat, DEFCON, BSides, APIDays)

About You

  • 4+ years of experience in backend engineering, security research, or applied R&D in a product environment

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and ability to work across domains (systems, networking, web architectures)

  • Proficient in at least one backend language (Python, Go, or similar)

  • Experience designing and shipping production systems with measurable impact

  • Ability to translate complex ideas or research into reliable, scalable implementations

  • Strong analytical mindset, with a focus on pragmatism and impact

  • Comfortable collaborating across engineering and security to deliver end-to-end solutions

Nice to have:

  • Experience in application security (web security, pentesting, bug bounty, etc.)

  • Exposure to AI/LLM-based systems

  • Familiarity with browser automation or large-scale distributed systems

Ready to lead the next wave of AI-powered vulnerability detection? Apply now to join Escape and make a real impact in cybersecurity!

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Redis
description_html:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Why would you love this job?

We seek a tenacious and results-driven Cloud Channel Sales Manager to spearhead our expansion into the cloud solutions realm. Bring your proven track record of aggressively pursuing and accelerating opportunities, coupled with a deep understanding of Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) like AWS, GCP, and Azure. As an ISV Partner sales expert, you'll leverage your expertise in selling PaaS solutions to deliver customer and partner presentations that resonate.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Hunt relentlessly for new cloud revenue opportunities and partnerships, driving pipeline generation and deal acceleration

  • Identify, pursue, and close strategic deals with CSPs, showcasing exceptional deal-making prowess

  • Plan and participate in regional events, generating leads and increasing pipe conversion with Cloud, reseller, and SI partners

  • Foster strong relationships with CSPs, emphasizing the unique value proposition of Redis Enterprise solutions

  • Cultivate new connections and leverage existing networks to build a robust pipeline of potential deals

  • Collaborate effectively with cloud providers, translating relationships into tangible co-sell opportunities registered through CSP partner tools

  • Create and execute comprehensive joint business plans for the region, including GTM strategies with VAR/Disti/Deployment Partners

  • Conduct on-site visits to cloud provider offices for account planning and technical enablement sessions

     

What will you need to have?

  • Demonstrated experience sourcing and influencing deals in the channel ecosystem with Cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at CENTRALE LYON
description_html:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.


Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area modelling; design space exploration and multi-objective optimization; hardwaresoftware co-design and workload mapping; emerging memories, compute-in-memory or photonic computing. Strong Python skills and sound software-engineering practice are essential; experience with SystemC, C/C++, RISCV simulation, QEMU, PyTorch/ONNX workload flows, architecture simulators (NeuroSim, CiMLoop/AccelForge, Timeloop or similar) will be appreciated. Familiarity with circuit-level modelling or EDA is an asset, but the focus is architectural and system-level research.

Environment: the position is hosted by the Electronics group at INL (UMR CNRS 5270), Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Écully, France – an interdisciplinary environment spanning devices, circuits, architectures, design automation, photonics and integrated systems, with national and European collaborations.

Starting date: Fall 2026

title: GTM Revenue Operations Lead
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Monday.com
description_html:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

We're looking for a GTM RevOps Lead to drive long-term GTM strategy and cross-regional initiatives across EMEA. This role reports to the EMEA Revenue Operations Director and operates as the RevOps strategic function's primary representative in the EMEA GM's leadership orbit.

You'll work closely with the EMEA GM, RVPs, and cross-functional partners (Finance, HR, Partner, Product) to shape our 1-3 year go-to-market plan - covering coverage model design, segment strategy, capacity planning, and the execution of high-priority strategic initiatives. You'll hold a formal contributor seat in EMEA GM-level forums (QBRs, strategy sessions, planning cycles), acting as the RevOps voice in those conversations and translating what you hear into rigorous workstreams back in the function.

Unlike the sub-regional BPs, this role operates at EMEA level: connecting the dots across geos, owning cross-cutting workstreams, and bringing structure and analytical rigour to the decisions that shape the region. You're the person who makes sure the GM's strategic agenda and the RevOps function's priorities are always in sync - without being pulled into operating rhythm ownership or CoS-type responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Drive EMEA GTM strategy across all sub-regions and segments: segmentation, territory design, coverage model, capacity, and investment priorities.

  • Partner with the EMEA GM and RVPs to define and maintain a 1 year regional growth roadmap with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Evaluate and build the business case for new routes to market - direct, partner, PLG, hybrid - including execution plans and success metrics.

  • Own cross-EMEA strategic initiatives from intake through to measurement.

  • Build and maintain long-range revenue and capacity models; run scenario planning to inform investment decisions across segments, motions, and sub-regions.

  • Identify structural gaps and opportunities (segment mix, deal size, win rates, coverage, partner co-sell attribution) and convert them into prioritised, resourced initiatives.

  • Drive insight on multi-product GTM penetration and AI adoption across the region; surface market-level trends and translate them into actionable recommendations.

  • Support EMEA RevOps operating cadence outputs - SOUs, QBR narratives, monthly leadership forums - with structured analysis and exec-ready content.

Requirements

  • 6-8+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy, BizOps, Management Consulting, or Finance - B2B SaaS required, EMEA scope strongly preferred.

  • Comfortable operating in senior leadership forums and influencing without authority - including at GM and RVP level.

  • Direct experience working with senior sales leadership on GTM strategy, planning cycles, and coverage model design.

  • Proven track record leading cross-functional strategic initiatives: new GTM motions, org design, segmentation changes, or partner model evolution.

  • Strong command of SaaS revenue metrics and pipeline analytics; comfortable building models and working in SFDC and BI tools.

  • Able to operate across multiple markets, currencies, and GTM maturity levels simultaneously.

  • Structured communicator: translates complex, ambiguous problems into clear recommendations and exec-ready outputs.

title: Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Airwallex
description_html:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our new SME team, selling into the eCommerce, SaaS and Professional Services industries. These are fast-growing businesses operating internationally, and we're the only fintech with the payment infrastructure, software and AI layer to streamline how they get paid, manage treasury and pay suppliers from one system. Your job is to understand their priorities, surface where their finance systems are holding them back, and build the case for change.

What you will be doing

Pipeline and new business generation

  • Territory planning: prioritising accounts and the people worth reaching out to, as well as identifying routes in through partners or leadership connections.

  • Owning your outbound strategy: building a hypothesis on what a business is prioritising and where things are likely breaking, then getting to the right people. Our product evolves quickly, so we need reps who develop new angles as they open up.

  • Running a proven sales process, and iterating on it: understanding a business's priorities, the challenges preventing them from executing, and building the ROI case with the customer.

  • Forecasting: using MEDDPICC to know where you are in a deal, where the gaps are, and to forecast accordingly.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Implementation and account management: coordinating implementation and handover, including the mutual action plans that keep everyone aligned on timelines and get the customer adopting quickly.

  • Product: relaying customer insight to the product team and influencing roadmap priorities.

  • Marketing: working together on ABM campaigns, competitive positioning and customer case studies.

What you bring

Experience

  • Ideally 3+ years of B2B software or fintech sales experience, with at least 1 year in an outbound closing role.

  • If you have 2+ years in an outbound lead generation role and have been deliberate about upskilling for a move into closing, apply and tell us how.

Skills and mindset

  • Curious: about the industries we sell into, the people we sell to, and our own product. You want to understand how things actually work, not just what to say about them. You think on your feet and you're clear and concise with your communication.

  • Perceptive: you read a room, and you have genuine empathy for the people you're selling to and working alongside.

  • Driven: the motivation comes from you. You want to get better, and you keep working through the stretches where results lag effort.

  • Honest: you bring problems forward early rather than letting them surface late, and you're upfront when you don't know something.

  • Coachable: you take feedback and act on it quickly, while being critical enough about what you hear to apply it selectively.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

About the team

The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.

What you'll do

As Senior Sales Manager, SME and Growth, you will lead, coach and develop a team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers in the UK. You will own team-level commercial performance, improve sales execution and build a predictable, data-driven revenue engine through disciplined pipeline management, forecasting and deal coaching. This is a hands-on player-coach role where you will support complex opportunities, develop Account Executive capability, strengthen outbound motions with Sales Development and Marketing, and help shape the UK go-to-market strategy. You will work closely with Product, Account Management, Revenue Strategy & Operations, GTM Partnerships and other regional stakeholders to turn customer and market insight into growth. This role is based in London.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers, setting clear expectations for customer engagement, pipeline quality, sales execution and revenue delivery.

  • Run a consistent sales operating rhythm through regular one-to-ones, call coaching, deal strategy sessions, live opportunity reviews, pipeline reviews, forecast reviews and quarterly business reviews.

  • Embed MEDDPICC, SPICED, Challenger or an equivalent sales methodology across the team, driving rigorous qualification, multi-threading, persona-based messaging, clear next steps and close planning.

  • Support strategic and complex opportunities by joining customer meetings, coaching negotiation and objection handling, engaging senior stakeholders and preserving clear Account Executive ownership throughout the sales cycle.

  • Build and improve outbound sales motions with Sales Development and Marketing by refining target segments, account coverage, messaging, outreach cadences and reporting.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM hygiene, data quality and forecasting discipline, using pipeline coverage, stage conversion, win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy to identify risks and prioritise action.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • At least 6 years of B2B sales experience, including significant experience as a closing Account Executive selling to SME, SMB or mid-market customers, and at least 2 years of frontline sales leadership experience managing, mentoring or coaching Account Executives in a quota-carrying sales environment.

  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding individual and team sales targets, with experience owning or contributing to a team quota.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, including discovery, value selling, negotiation, objection handling and close planning.

  • Strong practical knowledge of MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPICED, Challenger or an equivalent sales methodology, with the ability to train, inspect and reinforce its use across a team.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing pipeline, inspecting opportunities, forecasting accurately and maintaining disciplined CRM standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and performance-manage Account Executives, including providing clear feedback and addressing under-performance fairly and effectively.

  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, payments or financial services, together with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling multi-product fintech or payments solutions, such as payments, foreign exchange, business accounts, cards or spend management, to founders, CFOs, Finance, Operations or business-owner stakeholders.

  • Experience building or scaling a sales team, market, outbound motion or go-to-market strategy in the UK, EMEA or another developing market.

  • Experience implementing sales methodologies across a team, including creating enablement materials, inspection frameworks, coaching routines and performance measures.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and modern sales tools such as Gong, Chorus, Outreach, Salesloft or AI-enabled sales platforms, together with an interest in using data and technology to improve sales productivity.

  • Understanding of payments, KYC, AML, risk, compliance or other regulated financial-services workflows, or experience representing a company at market events and managing C-level customer relationships.
