title: Senior Data Engineer (Commercial Analytics)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Pleo
description_html:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role


Please note: applications will be open until Thursday 24th September 2026 09.00 CEST.
We will no review any applications before the closing date so everyone has equal chances to be selected. Use this time to submit a high quality application that will showcase your strengths.

 

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Growth Intelligence team at Pleo. In this role, you'll design and maintain the integration architecture and data contracts that connect our commercial and GTM data layer (the pipelines linking our CRM, billing, and customer success tooling to a central BigQuery warehouse) and be part of the team as we scale our commercial data foundations to support RevOps, Customer Success, and the AI products built on top of them. If you're excited about untangling complex, multi-system architecture and are passionate about building data foundations the whole business can trust, then this is the opportunity for you!

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Growth Intelligence and work closely with the RevOps and the BAT (Business Architecture & Technology) teams to understand what commercial operations needs from data. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to keeping Pleo's commercial and GTM data trustworthy and well-governed. You’ll also partner with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are modelling-ready, and engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to push data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

 

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines between commercial tools (HubSpot, Zuora, Vitally) and our BigQuery data warehouse.

  • Own reverse ETL flows: enrich or define data in the warehouse and push it back into operational tools like HubSpot, keeping definitions consistent across systems.

  • Implement and maintain data contracts with clear ownership, SLAs, and schema agreements between data producers (tool owners, product engineers) and data consumers (analysts, RevOps, AI tooling).

  • Partner with RevOps and the BAT team to understand operational data requirements and translate them into reliable, governed pipelines.

  • Build monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they surface in dashboards, operational reports, or downstream models.

  • Simplify integration architecture by centralising data flows through the warehouse, reducing point-to-point tool integrations and the maintenance burden that comes with them.

  • Work with Analytics Engineers to ensure pipeline outputs are structured and documented for downstream modelling.

  • Engage upstream with tool owners and engineering teams to move data quality and schema discipline closer to the source.

Our commercial data stack connects subscription billing (Zuora), CRM (HubSpot), and customer success tooling (Vitally) to a central BigQuery data warehouse. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: BigQuery, Python, HubSpot, Zuora, and Vitally plus dbt, Fivetran/Census, or Airflow depending on your background.

 

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines in a commercial or GTM data environment.

  • Strong understanding of CRM data models, APIs, and field management (HubSpot or comparable experience).

  • Hands-on experience with reverse ETL patterns: pushing warehouse-enriched or warehouse-defined data back into operational tools.

  • Extensive BigQuery experience.

  • Experience implementing data contracts in a production environment.

  • Python proficiency for pipeline development, transformation logic, and tooling.

  • Git-based workflows and CI/CD experience for data engineering code.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are equally excited by deep technical work as you are by collaborating with business stakeholders.

  • You can comfortably work with a wide variety of data sources and can operate within a complex multi-system environment.

  • You truly shine at solving problems and driving alignment between GTM/commercial stakeholders.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer to work on platform matters that are one step removed from the business.

  • You have never collaborated with senior stakeholders on GTM / commercial analytics work.

  • You need a very defined roadmap and backlog to operate efficiently. You'll need to adapt to rapid changes and be part of the roadmap definition discussions in this role.

 

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Become familiar with our data ecosystem and codebase.

  • Support to drive a HubSpot reimplementation project from the data side.

  • Collaborate with Data Platform & Analytics Engineers as well as GTM teams to improve or commercial analytics efforts.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

About the role

We are looking for an AML Analyst to join Pleo’s Decision Intelligence team and help strengthen how we detect, prevent, monitor, and respond to fraud risk across our financial crime decisioning setup.

This is not a traditional Fraud Operations case-handling role. You will work closer to the decisioning layer: helping translate fraud patterns into rules, monitoring rule performance, supporting rule testing, reviewing alert behaviour, and making sure fraud controls remain effective, explainable, and proportionate.

You will join at an important stage as Pleo continues to mature its fraud and AML decisioning capability. The right person will help improve speed, resilience, and quality in how we create, test, deploy, monitor, and tune fraud rules.

 

What you’ll be doing

You will help operate and improve Pleo’s fraud decisioning capability, with a focus on card fraud and related financial crime risk scenarios.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the end-to-end fraud rule lifecycle: from rule proposal and analysis through testing, deployment, monitoring, tuning, and rollback.

  • Working directly in, or closely with, decisioning tools and rule engines to support fraud detection logic.

  • Analysing fraud patterns, alert trends, false positives, false negatives, and rule performance.

  • Translating FraudOps insights and stakeholder requests into clear, structured rule proposals.

  • Helping assess whether new rules or threshold changes are justified by data.

  • Monitoring post-deployment rule performance and identifying when rules need adjustment.

  • Supporting daily operational requests related to fraud controls, while ensuring changes are traceable and well documented.

  • Partnering with FraudOps, AML, Product, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and Legal to make sure decisioning changes are aligned and risk-aware.

  • Maintaining clear documentation for fraud rules, rationale, expected impact, testing outcomes, and monitoring results.

  • Helping reduce single points of failure by building repeatable processes and stronger business continuity around fraud decisioning.

What we’re looking for

We are looking for someone who combines fraud domain knowledge with practical experience working in a decisioning environment.

You should have:

  • Experience as a Fraud Analyst, Risk Analyst, Fraud Strategy Analyst, Fraud Rules Analyst, Decisioning Analyst, or similar.

  • Hands-on experience with a decisioning tool, fraud rules engine, risk platform, or internal decisioning system.

  • Experience creating, testing, monitoring, or tuning fraud rules, thresholds, scenarios, or risk logic.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with data to assess rule performance and fraud patterns.

  • Good understanding of fraud typologies, especially card fraud, transaction fraud, account misuse, or payment fraud.

  • Ability to balance fraud prevention with customer impact and operational workload.

  • Experience working with false positives and understanding that good fraud controls require continuous monitoring and tuning.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain rule logic, rationale, risks, and expected outcomes clearly.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with FraudOps, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data teams.

  • A structured mindset and appreciation for documentation, traceability, governance, and change control.

  • Fintech, banking, payments, spend management, or regulated financial services.

  • SQL or basic data analysis.

 

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, success would look like:

  • You understand Pleo’s fraud decisioning setup and can confidently support day-to-day rule operations.

  • Fraud rule requests are better structured, documented, and traceable.

  • Rule changes are supported by data, clear rationale, and expected impact.

  • Post-deployment monitoring is more consistent and visible.

  • FraudOps and DI have a stronger operating rhythm for proposing, reviewing, deploying, and tuning fraud controls.

Why join us?

This is a rare opportunity to help shape a growing decisioning function from the inside. You will not just be reviewing fraud alerts, you will help define how fraud detection logic is built, governed, monitored, and improved.

You will join a team that is building the foundations for more scalable, data-driven, and resilient financial crime decisioning. If you enjoy working at the intersection of fraud strategy, operations, data, systems, and product, this role will give you real ownership and impact.

 

Apply if this sounds like you

You are analytical, structured, curious, and comfortable challenging assumptions. You know that fraud rules are never “set and forget.” You understand the importance of balancing risk reduction, customer experience, operational workload, and governance.

Most importantly, you have worked with decisioning tools or rule-based risk systems before and want to help build a stronger fraud decisioning capability at scale.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Behavior Planning
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Aerovect
description_html:
Who We Are

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer who can design and build best-in-class behavior planning systems for autonomous driving in structured, low-speed environments.

In this role, you'll own the design and implementation of key modules in the behavior planner — the decision-making layer that determines what the vehicle should do in complex, dynamic airside scenarios. You'll work at the intersection of mission-level goals and motion-level execution, tackling problems in multi-agent interaction modeling, rule-based and learned decision-making, and robust handling of edge cases unique to airport ground operations.

This opportunity offers a deeply technical engineer the chance to shape a market-defining enterprise product that combines autonomous vehicle technology with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model. This role reports to our Planning Tech Lead and works closely with the autonomy engineering team.

You Will

  • Develop and implement advanced behavior planning algorithms for autonomous vehicles

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure robust integration and functionality of planning systems

  • Design, write, and maintain efficient and scalable code in C++ and Python

  • Contribute to the architecture and continuous improvement of behavior planning software

  • Conduct extensive testing in simulated environments and real-world scenarios to validate and refine behavior planning algorithms

  • Analyze system performance and implement enhancements based on data and feedback

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of code, algorithms, and system designs

  • Work closely with other engineering teams to ensure seamless coordination and development

You Have

  • Proficient in modern C++ (11/14/17) and object-oriented programming

  • Skilled in Python for rapid prototyping and testing

  • Strong in debugging, profiling, and optimizing code

  • Deep understanding of behavior planning algorithms such as state machines, behavior trees, and probabilistic planning

  • Familiarity with path planning algorithms like A*, RRT, or optimization-based methods

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field

  • Minimum of 3 years of industry experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or a related field

We Prefer

  • Knowledge of state machines, behavior trees, and decision-making under uncertainty

  • Expertise in path planning algorithms such as A*, D*, and Rapidly-exploring Random Trees (RRT)

  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques, especially in the context of behavior prediction and planning

  • Experience with ROS / ROS2

  • Implementing systems that can re-plan at high frequencies to adapt to dynamic changes in the environment

  • Ensuring that behavior planning algorithms can execute with minimal latency for real-time navigation

  • Proficiency in optimization techniques and probabilistic models for making informed planning decisions under uncertainty

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Robotics, AI, Mathematics, or a related field with a focus on planning, optimization, or control theory is a plus

title: QA Tester - Brookhaven

description_html:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are one of the biggest Roblox studios by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 95+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

Role Overview

Driving Empire is one of the leading driving games on Roblox, and every update matters. You’ll think like a player, test like a creator, and partner closely with developers and artists to make sure every new feature, vehicle, and update delivers a great player experience.

🌟 If you live and breathe Roblox, notice the small details others miss, and love digging into games to find what could be better — this is your opportunity to make a huge impact on a game played by millions.

What You’ll Do

  • Test Driving Empire in both a LIVE and QA environment across Mobile, Tablet, PC, and Console, ensuring comprehensive coverage & that issues are identified early

  • Reproduce and document issues with complete supporting materials (logs, screenshots, reproduction steps)

  • Conduct testing from a player-experience perspective, representing Brookhaven’s community voice

  • Collaborate with the QA Lead to create and execute comprehensive test plans which anticipate issues ahead of release

  • Work closely with other QA testers by communicating progress, risks, and test results clearly to ensure effective coverage across tests

Who You Are

  • Proficient in written and spoken English communication

  • Experience as an active player on the Roblox platform with a strong understanding of Roblox player behaviour

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies, issues, or things that don’t look right

  • Ability to clearly and concisely present complex information in an understandable way

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines

  • Able to remain focused and methodical when approaching repetitive or high-volume tasks

  • Ability to work and communicate effectively with people at all levels

  • Ability to work full-time (40+ hours per week)

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working on Roblox games professionally

Tech Stack

title: Creative Designer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Neolymp
description_html:
Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt.

Wer wir sind

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop.

Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt.

Warum diese Rolle

  • Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt.
  • Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.
  • Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt.
  • Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.
  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives

  • Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter.
  • Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content

  • Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform.
  • Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen.

Shop, Amazon & Brand

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle Bannerbilder, Kampagnen-Visuals und Shopbilder – von Landingpage-Headern.
  • Du hältst unser visuelles Erscheinungsbild über alle Kanäle konsistent und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

Produktion & Workflow

  • Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand.
  • Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur.
  • Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy.
  • Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets.

Das zählt für uns am meisten

  • Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs).
  • Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify (Bildformate, Theme-Assets) oder Amazon-Bildrichtlinien.
  • Erfahrung im Fitness- oder Sport-Umfeld.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt unter „außerdem wichtig“? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert dein Portfolio und wie du denkst – nicht, ob du jede Zeile abhaken kannst.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Zu Shootings triffst du das Team vor Ort – der Rest läuft von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware und den Tools, die du brauchst, erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst das visuelle Erscheinungsbild einer wachsenden Marke und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Inhouse-Creative-Produktion aktiv mit – inklusive KI-basierter Workflows.

title: VP Engineering (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Synagen GmbH
description_html:
About Synagen

Synagen builds AI copilots for oncologists. We help clinical teams bring together patient information, medical evidence and treatment options when decisions matter most.

We are physicians, AI researchers and engineers working closely with hospitals and oncology care providers. Our goal is to turn advances in AI into reliable software that makes a measurable difference in everyday cancer care.

Tasks

The role

As VP Engineering, you will build and lead the engineering organisation behind our AI platform. Your mandate is clear: turn product requirements and validated AI concepts into reliable, scalable and maintainable software. You will own engineering delivery, architecture, technical quality and engineering culture while remaining hands-on where it matters.

What you'll do

  • Build and lead the engineering organisation.
  • Own engineering delivery from architecture through production.
  • Turn product requirements into pragmatic technical designs and execution plans.
  • Raise the bar for quality, reliability, security and engineering excellence.
  • Stay hands-on through architecture, critical implementation and technical leadership.

Requirements

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and leading engineering teams in a fast-moving product company.
  • A track record of taking products from prototype to production while scaling engineering teams, processes and technical foundations from early-stage through growth.
  • Strong engineering judgement across modern Python-based backend systems, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems and AI-enabled products.
  • Experience building and operating LLM or agentic systems in production, including evaluation, guardrails and failure handling.
  • You use modern AI coding tools as a core part of your engineering workflow and can effectively review and quality-control AI-generated code.
  • Evidence of making fast, high-quality decisions under ambiguity, including deciding what not to build.
  • Experience in healthcare, clinical workflows, FHIR, regulated or safety-critical software, or enterprise software deployments is a strong advantage, but not required.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. German is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

What we offer

  • End-to-end ownership of engineering, technology and delivery.
  • A product used in everyday oncology care, with the opportunity to shape its next stage of growth.
  • A small, senior and highly collaborative team of physicians, AI researchers and engineers.
  • Competitive compensation, including virtual stock options depending on experience and scope.
  • A pragmatic, low-bureaucracy environment with high autonomy and fast decision-making.
  • A fast, thoughtful hiring process that respects your time.

We welcome international candidates and run our hiring process in English.

Apply

Tell us about one product you helped take from ambiguity to production: what you owned, what you decided not to build and what changed for users. If you’ve built something you’re particularly proud of, we’d love to see it.

title: Werkstudent:in Marketing & Kommunikation (m/w/d) - Standort Berlin (hybrid)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Eventfrog
description_html:
Wir arbeiten standortübergreifend und nach den Prinzipien der Holacracy: ohne starre Hierarchien, dafür mit viel Eigenverantwortung, Autonomie und Raum für eigene Ideen. Als Werkstudent:in arbeitest du aktiv an unseren Marketingprojekten mit und gestaltest mit uns, wie Eventfrog weiterwächst. Eventfrog ist eine Event- und Ticketing-Plattform mit dem Ziel, die Eventbranche zu revolutionieren. Wir wollen Veranstalter:innen – vom kleinen Verein bis zum Großevent – erfolgreicher machen, zu einer vielfältigen und lebendigen Kulturlandschaft in Europa beitragen und einen Gegenpol zum Gigantismus der Eventindustrie schaffen.
Dafür bietet Eventfrog ein professionelles, gebührenfreies Online-Ticketing sowie zahlreiche Funktionen für die Organisation, Vermarktung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen – von mehr Reichweite über den Ticketverkauf und Einlass bis zum bargeldlosen Bezahlen. In der Schweiz betreibt Eventfrog den größten Veranstaltungskalender und expandiert mit seiner Event- und Ticketing-Plattform in weitere europäische Märkte.

Aufgaben

Wie deine Arbeit aussehen wird

  • Du erstellst Content für unsere Website und Social-Media-Kanäle – von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Marketingprojekten und übernimmst dabei auch eigene Aufgaben und kleinere Projekte.
  • Du betreust unsere Social-Media-Community, interagierst mit unseren Nutzer:innen und beantwortest Fragen.
  • Du beobachtest Trends und Entwicklungen auf Social Media und bringst eigene Ideen für neue Inhalte und Formate ein.
  • Du unterstützt das Marketingteam dort, wo gerade etwas bewegt werden soll – und bekommst dabei Einblick in unterschiedliche Bereiche unseres Marketings.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in und kannst uns 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen.
  • Du hast Lust auf Marketing, Kommunikation und Social Media und möchtest praktische Erfahrung sammeln.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbständig und zuverlässig und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Content, Sprache und unterschiedliche Zielgruppen.
  • Du kennst die gängigen Social-Media-Plattformen und hast Freude daran, neue Trends und Formate auszuprobieren.
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, bringst eigene Ideen ein und bist offen dafür, Neues zu lernen.
  • Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau.

Benefits

Worauf du dich freuen kannst

  • Flexibles und autonomes Arbeiten (Homeoffice unkompliziert und flexibel möglich)
  • New Work & Holacracy
  • Ein kompetentes, interdisziplinäres Team mit offenem Arbeitsklima

  • Eigenständige Durchführung von Bauteilprüfungen an GHH-Produkten (gummigefederte Räder, Vollräder, Komponenten, Elastomer-Bauteile) entsprechend der jeweiligen Anforderung
  • Montage, Demontage von GHH-Produkten

  • Erarbeitung von Prüfspezifikationen/Dokumentationen/Prüfberichten
  • Erstellung konstruktiver Entwürfe in CAD (SolidWorks): Vorrichtungen für Bauteilprüfungen und/oder konstruktive Modifikationen an bestehenden Bauteilen (z.B. Radreifen, Radkörpern oder Klemmringen) damit erforderliche Bauteilprüfungen ermöglicht werden
  • Abstimmung der Beschaffung der konstruktiven Entwürfe intern/extern

Vorbereitung von Prüfaufgaben, wie Kleben von Dehnmessstreifen oder Verkabelung verschiedener Sensoren

  • Erstellung von Prüfprogrammen in der entsprechenden Prüf-Software
  • Programmierung von Skripten zur Auswertung der Messdaten in Matlab, Famos oder Python

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Maschinenbau-Studium mit Abschluss als Diplom-Ingenieur bzw. Master Engineering, vorzugsweise mit der Vertiefungsrichtung
    (Schienen-)Fahrzeug- oder Konstruktionstechnik
  • Kenntnisse aus dem Bereich der statischen und dynamischen Bauteilprüfung
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Elektrik, Elektronik oder Mechatronik sowie Interesse an Mess- und Sensortechnik
  • Programmierkenntnisse in den genannten Programmen
  • Willen, sich immer wieder in neue Themengebiete einzuarbeiten und die gewonnenen Kenntnisse anzuwenden
  • kommunikative Fähigkeiten und sicheres Auftreten
  • Kreative, offene und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Bereitschaft, neue Wege zu gehen und fachübergreifende Ansätze einzubeziehen
  • Hohe Teamfähigkeit sowie Einsatzbereitschaft
  • sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Programmen und einem ERP-System
  • sehr gute Kenntnisse der englischen Sprache in Wort und Schrift
  • Bereitschaft zur flexiblen Arbeitszeitgestaltung
  • Körperliche Eignung für belastende körperliche Tätigkeiten und Arbeiten in verschiedenen Körperhaltungen
  • Bereitschaft zu Reisen, auch ins (außereuropäische) Ausland

Benefits

  • Gute Perspektiven und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einer wachsenden Branche
  • Möglichkeit zur persönlichen Entfaltung in einem traditionsreichen Umfeld
  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem Mittelstandsunternehmen mit sehr gutem Betriebsklima
  • Kurze Wege, offenes Miteinander und flache Hierarchien
  • Intensive Einarbeitung, breites Angebot an Fort- und Weiterbildungen sowie Raum
    zur persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Zentrale Lage in Oberhausen-Sterkrade (5 Gehminuten vom Bahnhof entfernt),
    gute Anbindung an das Autobahnnetz
  • Kostenlose Mitarbeiterparkplätze
  • Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung
  • Möglichkeit des Bike-Leasing und der betrieblichen Altersversorgung
  • Betriebliche Zusatzkrankenversicherung

title: Station Manager (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Roadsurfer
description_html:
Why roadsurfer?

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Look forward to a collegial atmosphere with flat hierarchies, lots of fun and great team spirit, as well as regular team events such as joint sports sessions, barbecues or just an after-work drink at your station.

  • CAMPER BUDGET: You get an annual camper budget to experience the #happyroadsurfing lifestyle for yourself.

  • DISCOUNTS: Use our Corporate Benefits Platform and Family & Friends Discounts

The role - your passion

  • Your roadsurfer Station - Location Management: You take on the independent leadership and establishment of the location, closely collaborating with central departments to oversee day-to-day operations on-site

  • Process Optimization: You successfully implement existing standards and processes while contributing your own ideas (coordinating vehicle returns, handovers, and vehicle preparation)

  • Collaboration with roadsurfer Stations: You maintain constant communication with all international teams to ensure ongoing improvements

  • Team Leadership: As a Team Leader, you motivate and lead your on-site team. This includes onboarding, effective task planning, and quality control

  • Recruitment: You have control over building your team and seek the right talent for your location

  • Fleet Management: You always have an overview of the local vehicle fleet for rental and sales: documentation, maintenance, cleanliness, and coordination with local service partners

  • Customer Consultation: You advise customers on our products, myroadsurfer, abo, spots, and rent, and send them out as happy roadsurfers on the roads of Europe

What you need to surf the wave with us

  • Successfully completed training or studies in a relevant subject area or comparable qualification

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant work experience, preferably in areas such as car rental, tourism, or similar - career changers are welcome

  • Experience in leading employees or teams is advantageous

  • High service and customer orientation with a friendly and open demeanor

  • You are a hands-on and effective communicator

  • You are a resilient problem solver and highly organized

  • You speak excellent english, on top you also speak the language for the country you applied for fluently

  • Driver's license Class B

Your Salary
We ❤️ transparency. The salary range for this position is between 36,000 EUR and 38,000 EUR gross per year. We are currently introducing salary bands in our job descriptions to ensure that all employees are treated fairly. Once we get to know each other better during the application process and can assess your skills and experience more precisely, we will work together to determine which level within the salary band is the best fit for you. In an annual feedback meeting, your salary will be reviewed at least once a year.

Ready to surf?

We look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at

ABOUT #ROADSURFER

We are more than Europe's largest campervan rental company. In 2021 we launched our platform roadsurfer spots in addition to our other products rent, abo and sales – a platform where you can discover and book unique camping spots. But that’s only the beginning. We are growing fast, so hop on board and join us on our journey. The roadsurfer philosophy is simple: rent an RV, start your adventure, be happy. Come ride the wave with us!

title: Junior ML / AI Engineer - Team Data (H/F)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at WINAMAX
description_html:
Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?
 
Techniquement, Winamax c’est :
  • Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude
  • Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme
  • Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audiences

A PROPOS DU POSTE
 
Pour accompagner le développement de Winamax sur de nombreuses problématiques liées à l’analyse de données, nous recrutons un ML /AI Engineer.
 
Au sein de la team Data, tu participeras activement à la recherche et au développement de modèles de machine learning et d’IA générative afin de répondre à des problématiques complexes en optimisant les processus décisionnels, en automatisant des tâches, et en concevant des solutions innovantes adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.
 
Tu seras également impliqué(e) dans l'évaluation des performances des modèles, leur déploiement en production, ainsi que la veille technologique pour rester à la pointe des avancées en intelligence artificielle.
 
Tu as l'occasion unique de contribuer au développement de l’équipe avec un terrain de jeu fertile en attente d’innovation et de créativité !
 
 
LES MISSIONS DU POSTE
 
  • Identifier les besoins et les problématiques métiers et proposer des solutions concrètes et pragmatiques
  • Concevoir et maintenir des modèles de machine learning / IA générative
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et produit
  • Effectuer une veille active sur l’ensemble des sujets ML / IA
 
QUELQUES EXEMPLES DE PROJETS
 
  • Conception d’un Chatbot
  • POC d’IA générative (génération de documentation technique, veille réglementaire, RAG à usage interne ...)
  • Analyse et modélisation de données sur différents domaines (intégrité de jeu, addiction, …)
 
ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE
 
  • Stockage : RDS, S3, DynamoDB, Redis, Redshift
  • Orchestration de containers : ECS Fargate / EC2
  •  Jobs : Lambda, Batch
  • Workflows : AirflowML : SageMaker / ML Flow
  • BI : Quicksight
  • Langages : Python, Javascript (Node)
  • Streaming : Kafka
  • CI : Github Action
  • Monitoring : Cloudwatch, Grafana

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ
Profil alliant une expérience de production en IA et ML (en stage ou alternance) à une fine compréhension des architectures de modèles LLM. La maîtrise des environnements Cloud et les compétences avancées en développement Python sont complétées par un esprit proactif, systématiquement force de proposition, et d'excellentes aptitudes en communication.

MODALITÉS ASSOCIÉES AU POSTE
  • Poste à pourvoir en CDI (contrat à durée indéterminée) temps plein uniquement et dès que possible à Paris, France
  • Semaine en 4 jours
  • Rémunération : selon le profil + participation et intéressement

    • PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT
  • Premier échange avec le recruteur - 30min
  • Live coding avec le Lead Tech et un membre de l’équipe - 1h
  • Entretien avec le Lead Tech et un membre de l’équipe - 1h30
  • Entretien final avec le VP Engineering - 30min
    • POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?
     
    En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !
     
    • Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique 
    • Une semaine de travail en 4 jours pour la majorité de nos équipes
    • Choix de l'ordinateur : PC ou MAC
    • Participation à des conférences/événements tech
    • Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…)
    • Des possibilités de mobilité interne 
    • Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…)
    • Des primes d’intéressement et de participation

title: CDI - CHEF DE PRODUIT HOMME/SLG/CEINTURE (H/F)
description_html:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.

 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).

 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE RÔLE

Au sein du pôle Développement Maroquinerie, le/la Chef(fe) de produit est garant(e), du développement des produits et du suivi des collections. En lien direct avec la Responsable Développement Maroquinerie, il/elle intervient de manière autonome sur l'ensemble de son périmètre, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes, Création Produit, Merchandising et Production.

 

VOS MISSIONS  

  • Travail en autonomie sur les offres maroquinerie homme, petite maroquinerie, ceintures et projets VIP
  • Accompagnement des fabricants dans le développement des produits, sur la base du brief du studio et du brief merchandising, déplacements sur site à prévoir
  • Gestion du parc de fabricants en collaboration avec l’équipe production (identification des forces et faiblesses, contretype)
  • Propositions d’alternatives techniques auprès du studio et des fabricants, pour anticiper les problématiques industrialisation et costing dans le respect de l’intention créative
  • Pilotage du développement des prototypes et des échantillons dans le respect des délais, de la marge et du niveau de qualité
  • Visibilité prix tout au long de la collection et négociations dans le respect des objectifs de marge
  • En charge du référencements produits et garant de l’exactitude des nomenclatures produits
  • Mise à jour des plans de collection et outils de suivi de collections
  • Support argumentaires spécificités produits pour l’équipe merchandising
  • Gestion planning shooting packshot et conformité produit en lien avec l’équipe image
  • Participation aux organisations défilé (pointage collection, mises en place produit pour editing styling et fitting, packing collection)
  • Préparation et transmission des dossiers techniques aux équipes industrialisation et production.
  • Validations facture et suivi rigoureux des coûts engagés
  • Participation à l’amélioration en continue des process

 

VOTRE PROFIL

title: CDI - CHEF DE PRODUIT CHAINE & TRAME FEMME (H/F)
description_html:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

 

VOTRE RÔLE 

Le/La Chef de Produit Chaîne & Trame femme est en charge du développement des catégories tailleur, shirting et flou, en lien les équipes design, dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais.

VOS MISSIONS 

  • Produit :
    • Suivre le développement des modèles chaîne & trame femme du brief à la normalisation
    • Participer à la mise au point des produits (prototypes, essayages, validations) et garantir la qualité, le bien-aller et l’information.
  • Coûts :
    • Contribuer au respect des cibles prix et marge, en intégrant les contraintes industrielles dès le développement et en proposant des optimisations .
  • Suivi & coordination :
    • Piloter les échanges avec les façonniers, assurer le lien opérationnel avec le studio, l’atelier et la production, et garantir la bonne circulation de l’information.
    • Suivre l’avancement des développements, anticiper les risques et veiller au respect des diffèrent jalons de développement.
 

VOTRE PROFIL 

  • Vous justifiez d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans sur la catégorie Chaîne & Trame, idéalement acquise dans un environnement mode/luxe exigeant.
  • Vous maîtrisez les techniques de développement produit (du brief à la normalisation) ainsi que les enjeux de construction, de matière et de bien-aller propres au tailleur, au shirting et au flou.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec le Pack Office ; une bonne connaissance d'un outil PLM est un plus apprécié.
  • Vous savez évoluer avec agilité dans un environnement créatif, exigeant et rythmé par des délais courts.
  • Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous portez une attention particulière au détail et à la qualité d'exécution.
  • Votre sens de l'adaptation vous permet de gérer plusieurs développements en parallèle, avec des priorités changeantes.
  • Vous disposez d'un excellent relationnel, indispensable pour fédérer les équipes internes (studio, atelier, production) et piloter efficacement vos partenaires façonniers.
 
Ce poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris.

title: Gestionnaire RH & Paie H/F
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Everfield
description_html:
À propos d'Everfield

Everfield achète, développe et accompagne la croissance d'éditeurs de logiciels métiers et spécialisés en Europe, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l'ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l'écosystème logiciel européen.

Les entreprises de l'écosystème Everfield évoluent selon un modèle décentralisé : elles conservent leur équipe, leur marque et leurs bureaux, et se concentrent sur ce qu'elles font de mieux, développer leurs produits et accompagner leurs clients. Everfield les épaule sur le recrutement et les RH, et leur donne accès à une équipe d'experts qui les conseille sur les aspects financiers et opérationnels de la construction et de la croissance des entreprises B2B SaaS européennes. Fondé en 2022, Everfield est déjà présent dans 7 pays, et continue de se développer.

Rôle

En tant que Gestionnaire RH & Paie, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le bon fonctionnement des opérations RH au sein des sociétés du portefeuille. En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe HR Business Partnering, vous gérerez l'administration RH, coordonnerez la paie et fournirez des données et rapports précis pour appuyer la prise de décision. Vous serez le premier point de contact pour les questions RH quotidiennes des collaborateurs, en garantissant un support RH rapide, précis et conforme. Ce rôle constitue le socle d'une gestion RH efficace, permettant aux dirigeants et aux HRBP de se concentrer sur les priorités stratégiques.

Responsabilités clés (liste non exhaustive)

  • Administration RH : gérer le cycle de vie des collaborateurs, y compris l'intégration, les départs et la gestion des absences. Rédiger et émettre les contrats de travail et leurs avenants, tenir à jour le SIRH, et administrer les avantages sociaux et régimes de retraite de l'entreprise.

  • Paie : préparer, traiter et valider la paie mensuelle des sociétés du portefeuille, en liaison avec le prestataire de paie externe. Garantir l'exactitude et le respect des délais.

  • Opérations RH : être le premier point de contact pour les questions des collaborateurs. Contribuer à la mise à jour des politiques et veiller au respect des exigences légales locales en matière de droit du travail.

  • Conformité : maintenir des dossiers du personnel exacts et à jour. Produire les courriers et modèles liés à l'emploi. Veiller à ce que la documentation soit prête pour un audit et conforme aux exigences légales et internes.

  • Données et reporting : garantir un haut niveau de fiabilité des données dans les systèmes RH. Fournir des données et rapports sur les collaborateurs pour alimenter les tableaux de bord, les analyses et la prise de décision.

  • Support HRBP & CoE : contribuer à la préparation des dossiers d'intégration, de la documentation disciplinaire, des enquêtes de départ, et des tâches RH opérationnelles. Apporter un soutien aux équipes CoE dans le déploiement de programmes.

Compétences et expérience requises

  • Expérience préalable en administration RH ou dans un poste RH opérationnel similaire, appréciée.

  • Expérience avec les systèmes RH (Workday souhaité).

  • Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite.

  • Solides capacités d'organisation et souci du détail.

  • Bonne compréhension du droit du travail local et des meilleures pratiques RH, indispensable.

  • Solides compétences en communication pour échanger avec les collaborateurs et parties prenantes à tous les niveaux.

  • Capacité à gérer des informations sensibles avec discrétion et confidentialité.

  • Esprit proactif et orienté solutions, avec la capacité à gérer efficacement plusieurs priorités.

  • Paie France - sécurité sociale et invalidité : expérience confirmée dans la gestion de ces dossiers spécifiques, incluant la relation avec les organismes concernés (CPAM, prévoyance, etc.), le traitement des arrêts maladie, congés maternité et situations d'invalidité sur les bulletins de paie, ainsi que la mise à jour des taux de cotisation lors des révisions annuelles.

  • Anglais courant (C1 - C2)

Localisation : France (Télétravail)
Département : Ressources Humaines
Type de contrat : CDI, Temps plein

title: AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at The Exploration Company
description_html:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

  • Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

  • Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

  • Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

  • Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

  • Good English communication skills (French would be a plus).

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Senior Sales Engineer - North America
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Camunda
description_html:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Sales Engineer, it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.

You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.

In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.

The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.

This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.

What you'll be doing:

In this role you will:

  • Map customer requirements to our Camunda product portfolio

  • Position potential quantitative and qualitative business value of Camunda

  • Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects

  • Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions

  • Support the completion of RFI / RFP documents

  • Team with Account Executives to develop accounts

  • Organize and execute pre-sales engagements

  • Implement code snippets

  • Create and maintain pre-sales content and technical artifacts

What you bring:

  1. Strong Technical Foundation:
     A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Solid understanding of programming fundamentals, modern software engineering practices, and common IT/system architectures.

  2. Proven Sales Engineering Experience:
     Experience in Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales, with a deep understanding of sales cycles, value-based selling, and stakeholder engagement. Skilled in handling objections and driving deals to closure in a consultative selling environment.

  3. Communication Excellence:
     Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  4. Language Proficiency:
     Fluent in English (C1/C2 level or native proficiency)

  5. Travel Flexibility:
     Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, events, and team collaboration.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in enterprise automation, business process management (BPM), process orchestration, robotic process automation (RPA), Agentic-AI or similar domains.

  • Familiarity with value-based selling, including conducting value workshops and applying value engineering frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of the process automation and orchestration product landscape and key industry players.

  • Industry experience in BFSI, Telecommunications, or Logistics.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AL1 #LI-Remote #USEAST #USWEST

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $175,200.00 to $282,400.00

  • United Kingdom: £110,000.00 to £180,900.00

  • Singapore: S$217,500.00 to S$326,300.00

  • Canada: C$186,000 to C$305,900

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description_html:
Overview

We are looking for a motivated Working Student IT Administration to join our IT Administration team. This is a great opportunity to gain practical, hands-on experience in corporate IT alongside your studies, in a hybrid role that offers flexibility and real responsibility from day one.


Your Role

  • Supports the IT Administration team in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of internal
    IT systems, hardware and workplace technology
  • Assists with employee IT support by helping with hardware setup, software installation, user
    account management and basic troubleshooting
  • Supports onboarding and offboarding activities by preparing devices, managing access
    requests and maintaining IT equipment
  • Helps maintain IT inventory, hardware documentation, software licenses and internal records
  • Assists with basic system administration tasks, device management, and office IT
    infrastructure under the guidance of the IT Administration Team Lead
  • Contributes to improving IT documentation, knowledge base articles and internal processes
  • Works closely with colleagues across the company to provide friendly and reliable IT support
    while gaining practical experience in corporate IT administration


Your Profile

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Information technology, Business Informatics or a related field
  • Basic understanding of computer hardware, operating systems, networks and common workplace software
  • Interest in IT support, systems administration and learning about enterprise IT environments
  • Hands-on, reliable and eager to solve technical problems and support colleagues
  • Structured way of working with good organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong communication skills and a service-oriented mindset
  • Fluent in English; German is a plus


Nice To Have

  • Active Directory
  • M365 (Exchange Online, Sharepoint, Teams)
  • Microsoft Intune
  • Github
  • Terraform


Why you will love working with us

  • Work-life balance: Enjoy our flexible processes that allow you to work in a hybrid mode: either from home, your workation or our Berlin office, as we love to meet and connect from time to time in person. On top of that, we also offer 30 paid vacation days
  • Based in the heart of Berlin: Our spacious and loft-style headquarters is located in a historic building at the heart of Berlin, with a nice view of the TV Tower and convenient connections to all parts of the city – thanks to U1, U2, U6, M41 and S-Bahn at Anhalter Bahnhof
  • Learning & development: A team that fosters growth and values knowledge sharing. With dedicated training days, learning subscriptions, a personal development budget and clear growth goals, we’ll empower you to reach your next career milestone and beyond!
  • Team events: Coffee Breaks, Chats ‘n’ Cheers, Brunches, All-Hands Meetings: our company culture is vivid and open for new ideas that are inclusive, diverse and fun!
  • Competitive compensation: Excellent people deserve great working conditions. We conduct annual compensation reviews to ensure that we are paying salaries above the market average
  • Perks: Urban Sports Club discount, company pension subsidy, discounts, subsidized public transport ticket: our teams enjoy numerous perks beyond the fruit basket and coffee flat rate

title: Technical Sourcer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Arago
description_html:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Technical Sourcer at Arago, you will own the search for some of the most sought-after engineers in the world. We build hardware that has never existed before, and finding the people who can build it requires going far beyond standard recruiting channels.

You will own the full sourcing motion: mapping talent pools, building precise searches, crafting outreach that resonates with passive candidates, and building long-term relationships with high-priority profiles. Working directly with hiring managers and founders, you will develop a deep understanding of each role and the technical landscape around it, then go find the right people, wherever they are.

Responsibilities

  • Build highly targeted searches for Arago's most critical roles, ASIC architects, packaging engineers, mixed-signal verification, SW systems leads

  • Craft outreach that engages passive candidates and builds long-term relationships with high-priority targets

  • Develop creative sourcing strategies: GitHub, research communities, referral networks, X-Ray etc.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to build customized sourcing strategies

  • Own candidate tracking, pipeline metrics, and funnel data with a structured approach

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

We're Looking For

  • Proven sourcing experience in deep tech, semiconductors, or AI hardware, not just software

  • X-Ray search skills and comfort sourcing across GitHub, LinkedIn, and non-traditional channels

  • Demonstrated success sourcing passive senior technical talent

  • Ability to run multiple complex searches in parallel without dropping quality

  • Genuine curiosity about the technology, you need to understand what you're sourcing for

  • A long-game mindset: relationship building over transactional outreach

Nice to Have

  • Sourcing experience in technical domains

  • Proven track record of filling hard-to-find roles

  • Experience writing outreach that actually gets replies

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with multiple open roles simultaneously

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of AI at Arago.

title: Senior Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Gladia
description_html:
About Gladia

Gladia builds the audio AI infrastructure behind the new generation of voice products. Our mission is to give every voice platform true conversational intelligence — the audio infrastructure that understands every conversation, turning voice into the world's most valuable data layer.

Our API turns real-world conversational audio into accurate, structured, real-time output — powered by our proprietary Solaria ASR, across 100+ languages, with industry-leading latency.

Hundreds of companies build their voice products on Gladia — from meeting assistants and voice agents to sales-enablement and contact-center platforms. We started in Paris, our growth is developer-led and heavily US-driven (and we're going after the US market hard).

Headquartered in vibrant tech hubs like Paris and New York City, Gladia has been by OVH Groupe — Europe's leading cloud provider — and now operates as a fully autonomous brand and company within the Group.

We're guided by four values:

  • Honest — Say the real thing, kindly.

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.

As a Senior AE, you'll uncover the challenges organisations ( voice agents, meeting assistants, contact-center platforms) face when they build and run Speech AI at scale and land the right Gladia solution for them. You'll sell a technical, usage or contract based API product to engineering and business stakeholders. Based in Paris. Reporting to Head of Sales.

The role

  • Run a rigorous, repeatable sales process across a range of company types and buyer profiles — from developer-led teams to enterprise buying committees.

  • Own the relationship map for your territory: existing accounts and the aspirational logos you want to win.

  • Build a deep understanding of each customer's business and the technical problem they're solving.

  • Negotiate pricing and terms by selling value and ROI, not discounts.

  • Expand reach and depth across your territory — grow existing accounts while landing new logos.

  • Navigate complex, technical deals with resourcefulness, and know intuitively what it takes to get to close.

  • Work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers in complex Sales cycles and Gladia evaluations
